/* ============================================================================
 * AIDRPG v1.2.5 FINAL RELEASE OVERRIDE
 * Paste-ready readable layer.
 * Goals:
 * - Restore separated hook bodies for AI Dungeon.
 * - Do not run Story Card compaction inside Input Modifier.
 * - Add bounded fast paths for known timeout/edge cases.
 * - Keep unmanaged/player Story Cards safe.
 * ========================================================================== */
;(function installAIDRPG124Final(A) {
  "use strict";

  if (!A || A.__aidrpg124FinalRelease === true) {
    return;
  }

  const FINAL_VERSION = "1.2.5-production";
  const FINAL_STAGE = "AIDRPG-v1.2.5-final-release";

  function text(value) {
    return String(value == null ? "" : value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  function lower(value) {
    return text(value).toLowerCase().replace(/[–—]+/g, "-");
  }

  function key(value) {
    if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.toKey === "function") {
      return A.Utils.toKey(value);
    }
    return lower(value).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
  }

  function hash(value) {
    if (A.TurnEngine && typeof A.TurnEngine.stableHash === "function") {
      return A.TurnEngine.stableHash(value);
    }
    const str = String(value || "");
    let h = 5381;
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i += 1) {
      h = ((h << 5) + h) ^ str.charCodeAt(i);
      h >>>= 0;
    }
    return String(h);
  }

  const NUMBER_WORDS = {
    a: 1, an: 1, one: 1, two: 2, three: 3, four: 4, five: 5,
    six: 6, seven: 7, eight: 8, nine: 9, ten: 10, eleven: 11,
    twelve: 12, thirteen: 13, fourteen: 14, fifteen: 15,
    sixteen: 16, seventeen: 17, eighteen: 18, nineteen: 19,
    twenty: 20, thirty: 30, forty: 40, fifty: 50, sixty: 60,
    seventy: 70, eighty: 80, ninety: 90
  };

  function numberFrom(value) {
    const clean = lower(value).replace(/-/g, " ");
    if (/^\d+$/.test(clean)) return Number(clean);
    if (NUMBER_WORDS[clean]) return NUMBER_WORDS[clean];
    let total = 0;
    const parts = clean.split(/\s+/);
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i += 1) {
      total += NUMBER_WORDS[parts[i]] || 0;
    }
    return total || 0;
  }

  function pushUnique(list, value, cap) {
    if (!Array.isArray(list) || !value) return 0;
    if (list.indexOf(value) === -1) list.push(value);
    if (cap) while (list.length > cap) list.shift();
    return 1;
  }

  function softLog(root, message) {
    try {
      if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.logEvent === "function") {
        A.Utils.logEvent(message);
        return;
      }
      root.logs = root.logs || {};
      root.logs.recentEvents = Array.isArray(root.logs.recentEvents) ? root.logs.recentEvents : [];
      root.logs.recentEvents.push({
        turn: root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0,
        hook: root.meta && root.meta.currentHook ? root.meta.currentHook : "",
        message: message
      });
      while (root.logs.recentEvents.length > 30) root.logs.recentEvents.shift();
    } catch (_error) {}
  }

  function initializeForHook(includeContextSystems) {
    if (A.CoreState && typeof A.CoreState.init === "function") A.CoreState.init();
    const root = state.aidrpg;
    const systems = [
      "PlayerSystem",
      "BuildIdentitySystem",
      "ProgressionSystem",
      "StatBenchmarkSystem",
      "ActorThreatProfileSystem",
      "InventorySystem",
      "SceneStateSystem",
      "WorldEntitySystem",
      "TimeTravelSystem",
      "ReputationSystem",
      "QuestLogSystem",
      "AbilitySystem",
      "PersistentTraitSystem",
      "SpecializationSystem",
      "ActorProfileSystem",
      "MajorActorMemorySystem"
    ];
    if (includeContextSystems) systems.push("ContextPacketSystem");
    // CardSync is intentionally initialized, but not allowed to scan Story Cards on Input.
    systems.push("CardSyncSystem");
    for (let i = 0; i < systems.length; i += 1) {
      const system = A[systems[i]];
      try {
        if (system && typeof system.init === "function") system.init(root);
      } catch (error) {
        softLog(root, "Init fail-soft: " + systems[i]);
      }
    }
    if (A.ConsequenceParser && typeof A.ConsequenceParser.init === "function") {
      try { A.ConsequenceParser.init(root); } catch (_error) {}
    }
    if (A.ValidationSystem && typeof A.ValidationSystem.init === "function") {
      try { A.ValidationSystem.init(root); } catch (_error) {}
    }
    return root;
  }

  function parseDurationMinutes(rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const s = lower(raw).replace(/-/g, " ");
    let match;

    if (/\b(?:a\s+)?quarter\s+(?:of\s+an?\s+)?hour\b/.test(s)) return 15;
    if (/\bhalf\s+an?\s+hour\b/.test(s)) return 30;
    if (/\bthree\s+quarters?\s+of\s+an?\s+hour\b/.test(s)) return 45;
    if (/\bmoments?\s+later\b/.test(s)) return 2;
    if (/\bseveral\s+minutes?\b/.test(s)) return 5;
    if (/\ba\s+few\s+minutes?\b/.test(s)) return 3;
    if (/\b(?:camp|camped)\s+for\s+the\s+night\b|\bwake\s+at\s+dawn\b|\bsleep\s+overnight\b/.test(s)) return 480;
    if (/\b(?:a\s+)?day\s+and\s+a\s+half\b/.test(s)) return 2160;

    match = s.match(/\b(?:(an?|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|\d+)\s+)?hours?\s+and\s+a\s+quarter\b/);
    if (match) return (numberFrom(match[1] || "one") || 1) * 60 + 15;

    match = s.match(/\b(?:(an?|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|\d+)\s+)?hours?\s+and\s+a\s+half\b/);
    if (match) return (numberFrom(match[1] || "one") || 1) * 60 + 30;

    match = s.match(/\b([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+hours?\s+and\s+([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+minutes?\b/);
    if (match) return numberFrom(match[1]) * 60 + numberFrom(match[2]);

    match = s.match(/\b(?:trip|journey|voyage|route|crossing|expedition|trail|road|walk|ride|ferry|climb|vigil)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:takes?|lasts?)\s+([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+(weeks?|months?|years?|days?|hours?|minutes?)\b/);
    if (match) {
      const amount = numberFrom(match[1]) || 1;
      const unit = match[2];
      if (unit.startsWith("year")) return amount * 525600;
      if (unit.startsWith("month")) return amount * 43200;
      if (unit.startsWith("week")) return amount * 10080;
      if (unit.startsWith("day")) return amount * 1440;
      if (unit.startsWith("hour")) return amount * 60;
      return amount;
    }

    match = s.match(/\b([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+(years?|months?|weeks?)\s+(?:pass|passes|passed|later|go\s+by|elapse|elapsed)\b/);
    if (match) {
      const amount = numberFrom(match[1]) || 1;
      const unit = match[2];
      if (unit.startsWith("year")) return amount * 525600;
      if (unit.startsWith("month")) return amount * 43200;
      return amount * 10080;
    }

    match = s.match(/\b([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+days?\b/);
    if (match) return (numberFrom(match[1]) || 0) * 1440;

    match = s.match(/\b([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+hours?\b/);
    if (match) return (numberFrom(match[1]) || 0) * 60;

    match = s.match(/\b([a-z]+(?:\s+[a-z]+)?|\d+)\s+minutes?\b/);
    if (match) return numberFrom(match[1]) || 0;

    return 0;
  }

  function shouldFastApplyTime(rawText) {
    const s = lower(rawText);
    if (!parseDurationMinutes(rawText)) return false;
    if (/\b(?:poison|venom|wounded|bleeding|gash|practice|cast|absorb|merchant|shield|token|sword|tavern|village|mira|talla|bram|crown|god|golem|king|court|Firecat|Tower\s+Shield|Dragon\s+Roar)\b/i.test(rawText)) {
      return false;
    }
    return /\b(?:takes?|lasts?|pass(?:es|ed)?|later|wait|sleep|camp|wake|route|walk|trip|journey|crossing|climb|vigil|minutes?|hours?|days?|weeks?|months?|years?|quarter|half|dawn|night)\b/.test(s);
  }

  function absoluteMinutes(root) {
    const current = root.time.current || { day: 1, hour: 8, minute: 0 };
    return ((Number(current.day) || 1) - 1) * 1440 + (Number(current.hour) || 0) * 60 + (Number(current.minute) || 0);
  }

  function setClockFromAbsolute(root, minutes) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(minutes) || 0));
    root.time.current = root.time.current || { day: 1, hour: 8, minute: 0 };
    root.time.current.day = Math.floor(total / 1440) + 1;
    root.time.current.hour = Math.floor((total % 1440) / 60);
    root.time.current.minute = total % 60;
  }

  function applyTimeMinutes(root, rawText, minutes) {
    if (!minutes || minutes < 0) return 0;
    root.time = root.time || {};
    root.time.current = root.time.current || { day: 1, hour: 8, minute: 0, season: "", weather: "" };
    root.time.elapsed = root.time.elapsed || { totalHours: 0 };
    root.time._v124TimeKeys = Array.isArray(root.time._v124TimeKeys) ? root.time._v124TimeKeys : [];
    const turn = root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0;
    const opKey = turn + "|" + hash(text(rawText)) + "|" + minutes;
    if (root.time._v124TimeKeys.indexOf(opKey) !== -1) return 0;
    root.time._v124TimeKeys.push(opKey);
    while (root.time._v124TimeKeys.length > 40) root.time._v124TimeKeys.shift();

    setClockFromAbsolute(root, absoluteMinutes(root) + minutes);
    root.time.elapsed.totalHours = Math.round(((Number(root.time.elapsed.totalHours) || 0) + minutes / 60) * 100) / 100;
    if (root.meta && root.meta.dirty) root.meta.dirty.time = true;
    compactOwnedItemDuplicates(root);
    if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") A.Utils.invalidatePackets(root);
    return 1;
  }

  function addRouteMemory(root, rawText, minutes) {
    const match = text(rawText).match(/\broute\s+from\s+(.+?)\s+to\s+(.+?)\s+takes?\s+(.+?)(?:\.|,|$)/i);
    if (!match || !minutes) return 0;
    root.time = root.time || {};
    root.time.routes = root.time.routes || {};
    root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes = root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes || {};
    const fromName = text(match[1]);
    const toName = text(match[2]);
    const forward = "route_" + key(fromName) + "__" + key(toName);
    const reverse = "route_" + key(toName) + "__" + key(fromName);
    const row = function (a, b) {
      return {
        fromRef: a,
        toRef: b,
        minutes: minutes,
        lastActualMinutes: minutes,
        lastConfirmedTurn: root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0,
        symmetric: true
      };
    };
    root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes[forward] = row(fromName, toName);
    root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes[reverse] = row(toName, fromName);
    return 1;
  }

  function isNegativeAcquisition(rawText) {
    const s = lower(rawText);
    return /\b(?:almost|nearly)\s+(?:take|taking|grab|grabbing|pick\s*up|picking\s*up|get|getting|claim|claiming)\b/.test(s) ||
      /\breach(?:es|ed)?\s+for\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:but|then)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:stop|stops|stopped|does\s+not|doesn't|do\s+not|don't|leave|leaves|left|without\s+taking)\b/.test(s) ||
      /\bstarts?\s+to\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|get|claim)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:but|then)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:does\s+not|doesn't|do\s+not|don't|stops?|leaves?|left)\b/.test(s) ||
      /\b(?:do\s+not|don't|does\s+not|doesn't|did\s+not|didn't)\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|claim|get)\b/.test(s) ||
      /\b(?:dream|vision|imaginary|imagined)\b[^.!?]{0,120}\b(?:wake|wakes|awake)\b[^.!?]{0,80}\b(?:empty\s+hands|nothing)\b/.test(s);
  }

  function isNoItemSearch(rawText) {
    const s = lower(rawText);
    return /\b(?:find|finds|found)\s+(?:nothing|no\s+(?:item|items?|key|keys?|rusted\s+iron\s+key)|only\s+dust|nothing\s+(?:unusual|useful|of\s+value|important))\b/.test(s) ||
      /\bsearch(?:es|ed)?\b[^.!?]{0,100}\b(?:find|finds|found)\s+(?:nothing|no\s+(?:item|items?|key|keys?|rusted\s+iron\s+key)|only\s+dust|nothing\s+(?:unusual|useful|of\s+value|important))\b/.test(s);
  }

  function isDialogueOnlyAcquisition(rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText).replace(/[\u201c\u201d]/g, '"').replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'");
    const s = lower(raw);
    if (!/\b(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|get|claim|loot|collect)\b/.test(s)) return false;

    // If narration outside quoted speech confirms transfer, allow normal acquisition.
    const unquoted = raw.replace(/"[^"]{0,240}"/g, ' ').replace(/'[^']{0,240}'/g, ' ');
    const uq = lower(unquoted);
    if (/\byou\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|get|claim|collect|loot|find|buy|purchase|accept|receive)\b/.test(uq)) return false;
    if (/\b(?:hands?|gives?|presses|slips|places|puts|awards?|rewards?|presents?)\b[^.!?]{0,90}\b(?:you|your\s+(?:hand|palm|pack|pouch|bag|inventory))\b/i.test(unquoted)) return false;

    const quotedCommand = /"[^"]{0,220}\b(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|get|claim|loot|collect)\b[^"]{0,220}"/i.test(raw) &&
      /\b(?:says?|said|tells?|told|orders?|ordered|asks?|asked|whispers?|whispered|shouts?|shouted|warns?|warned|urges?|urged|commands?|commanded)\b/i.test(raw);
    const colonCommand = /\b(?:says?|said|tells?|told|orders?|ordered|asks?|asked|whispers?|whispered|shouts?|shouted|warns?|warned|urges?|urged|commands?|commanded)\b\s*:?[\s"']{0,4}(?:please\s+)?(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|get|claim|loot|collect)\b/i.test(raw);
    const speakerColon = /\b(?:npc|guard|merchant|priest|widow|mira|talla|seren|bram|captain\s+dorne|[A-Z][a-z]{1,24})\b\s*:\s*["']?(?:please\s+)?(?:take|grab|pick\s*up|get|claim|loot|collect)\b/i.test(raw);
    return quotedCommand || colonCommand || speakerColon;
  }

  function compactOwnedItemDuplicates(root) {
    if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return 0;
    const items = ensureInventory(root);
    const owned = Array.isArray(items.ownership && items.ownership.player) ? items.ownership.player : [];
    const seen = {};
    const keep = [];
    let changed = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < owned.length && i < 240; i += 1) {
      const id = owned[i];
      const rec = items.byId && items.byId[id] ? items.byId[id] : null;
      const normalized = key(rec && (rec.displayName || rec.baseType || rec.name) ? (rec.displayName || rec.baseType || rec.name) : id);
      if (!normalized) continue;
      if (seen[normalized]) {
        changed += 1;
        continue;
      }
      seen[normalized] = true;
      keep.push(id);
    }
    if (keep.length !== owned.length) {
      items.ownership.player = keep;
      changed += 1;
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function cleanItemPhrase(value) {
    let item = text(value)
      .replace(/^(?:a|an|the|some|your|my)\s+/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:in|inside|within|from)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:and|but)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:before|after|while|when|because|since|until)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:marked|etched|carved)\s+with\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/[.!?;,]+$/g, "")
      .trim();
    if (/^(?:nothing|no item|no items|only dust|dust|nothing unusual|nothing useful|and|it|them)$/i.test(item)) return "";
    if (/^(?:coins?|gold|silver|copper|money|three silver coins|seven copper coins)$/i.test(item)) return "";
    return item;
  }

  function ensureInventory(root) {
    if (A.InventorySystem && typeof A.InventorySystem.init === "function") {
      try { A.InventorySystem.init(root); } catch (_error) {}
    }
    root.items = root.items || {};
    root.items.byId = root.items.byId || {};
    root.items.ownership = root.items.ownership || {};
    root.items.ownership.player = Array.isArray(root.items.ownership.player) ? root.items.ownership.player : [];
    root.items.currency = root.items.currency || {};
    root.items.currency.byType = root.items.currency.byType || {};
    return root.items;
  }

  function grantItem(root, rawItem, source) {
    const item = cleanItemPhrase(rawItem);
    if (!item) return 0;
    const items = ensureInventory(root);
    const normalized = key(item);
    const owned = items.ownership.player;
    compactOwnedItemDuplicates(root);
    for (let i = 0; i < owned.length && i < 160; i += 1) {
      const rec = items.byId[owned[i]];
      if (rec && key(rec.displayName || rec.baseType || rec.name || "") === normalized) return 0;
    }
    const id = "item_" + normalized;
    if (!items.byId[id]) {
      items.byId[id] = {
        id: id,
        displayName: item,
        baseType: item.split(/\s+/).slice(-1)[0] || item,
        category: "item",
        state: "packed",
        source: source || "v124_fast_grant",
        notes: { sourceContext: source || "v124_fast_grant" }
      };
    }
    if (owned.indexOf(id) === -1) owned.push(id);
    if (root.meta && root.meta.dirty && Array.isArray(root.meta.dirty.items)) pushUnique(root.meta.dirty.items, id, 60);
    if (A.InventorySystem && typeof A.InventorySystem.refreshVisibleCarrySummary === "function") {
      try { A.InventorySystem.refreshVisibleCarrySummary(root); } catch (_error) {}
    }
    if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") A.Utils.invalidatePackets(root);
    return 1;
  }

  function addCurrency(root, amount, type) {
    const value = Number(amount) || numberFrom(amount);
    const currencyType = lower(type).replace(/s$/, "");
    if (!value || !/^(?:copper|silver|gold)$/.test(currencyType)) return 0;
    const items = ensureInventory(root);
    const byType = items.currency.byType;
    byType[currencyType] = (Number(byType[currencyType]) || 0) + value;
    return 1;
  }

  function splitLootList(value) {
    const cleaned = text(value).replace(/\s+and\s+/gi, ", ");
    return cleaned.split(/\s*,\s*/).map(cleanItemPhrase).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8);
  }

  function extractInventoryCandidates(rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const candidates = [];
    let match;

    const listPattern = /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:pick\s*up|claim|take|collect|loot|grab)\s+(.+?)(?:\.|$)/i;
    match = raw.match(listPattern);
    if (match) {
      const phrase = match[1].replace(/\b(?:and|plus)\s+(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+(copper|silver|gold)\s+coins?\b/ig, function (_m, amount, type) {
        candidates.push({ currency: true, amount: amount, type: type });
        return "";
      });
      const pieces = splitLootList(phrase);
      for (let i = 0; i < pieces.length; i += 1) candidates.push({ item: pieces[i] });
    }

    const currencyFirst = /\b(?:claim|take|collect|loot|grab|pick\s*up)\s+(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+(copper|silver|gold)\s+coins?\s+(?:and|plus)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i;
    match = raw.match(currencyFirst);
    if (match) {
      candidates.push({ currency: true, amount: match[1], type: match[2] });
      candidates.push({ item: match[3] });
    }

    const inContainer = /\byou\s+find\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90}?)\s+(?:in|inside|within|from)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?[^.!?;,]+/i;
    match = raw.match(inContainer);
    if (match) candidates.push({ item: match[1] });

    const searchAndFind = /\byou\s+search\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?[^.!?;,]{2,70}?\s+and\s+find\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90})(?=\.|,|;|$)/i;
    match = raw.match(searchAndFind);
    if (match) candidates.push({ item: match[1] });

    const giftPatterns = [
      /\b(?:hands?|gives?|presses|presents|slips)\s+you\s+(?:with\s+)?(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90})(?=\.|,|;|$|\s+into\s+your)/i,
      /\b(?:hands?|gives?|presses|presents|slips)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90}?)\s+into\s+your\s+(?:hand|palm|pack|bag)/i,
      /\brewards?\s+you\s+with\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,90})(?=\.|,|;|$)/i
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < giftPatterns.length; i += 1) {
      match = raw.match(giftPatterns[i]);
      if (match) candidates.push({ item: match[1] });
    }

    return candidates.slice(0, 12);
  }

  function applyEquipFromOutput(root, rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const match = raw.match(/\b(?:equip|equips|equipped|wield|wields|wielded|strap|straps|strapped)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s+(?:in|to|on|as)\s+(?:your\s+)?(main\s+hand|off\s+hand|left\s+hand|right\s+hand|head|body|chest|hands|feet|finger|neck|back))?(?=\.|,|;|$)/i) ||
      raw.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([^.!?;,]{2,80}?)(?:\s+is\s+)?equipped\s+(?:in|to|on|as)\s+(?:your\s+)?(main\s+hand|off\s+hand|left\s+hand|right\s+hand|head|body|chest|hands|feet|finger|neck|back)\b/i);
    if (!match) return 0;
    const itemName = cleanItemPhrase(match[1]);
    if (!itemName) return 0;
    grantItem(root, itemName, "equip_confirmed");
    const items = ensureInventory(root);
    const itemId = "item_" + key(itemName);
    const slotRaw = lower(match[2] || "main hand");
    const slot = slotRaw.indexOf("off") !== -1 || slotRaw.indexOf("left") !== -1 ? "offHand" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("head") !== -1 ? "head" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("body") !== -1 || slotRaw.indexOf("chest") !== -1 ? "body" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("hands") !== -1 ? "hands" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("feet") !== -1 ? "feet" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("finger") !== -1 ? "ring" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("neck") !== -1 ? "neck" :
      slotRaw.indexOf("back") !== -1 ? "back" : "mainHand";
    items.equipment = items.equipment || {};
    items.equipment[slot] = itemId;
    if (slot === "mainHand") items.equipment.main_hand = itemId;
    return 1;
  }

  function applyInventoryFast(root, rawText) {
    if (isDialogueOnlyAcquisition(rawText)) {
      softLog(root, "No acquisition granted from quoted/dialogue instruction.");
      compactOwnedItemDuplicates(root);
      return { handled: true, changed: 0 };
    }
    if (isNegativeAcquisition(rawText) || isNoItemSearch(rawText)) {
      softLog(root, "No acquisition granted from negated/search-empty wording.");
      return { handled: true, changed: 0 };
    }

    let changed = 0;
    const candidates = extractInventoryCandidates(rawText);
    for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i += 1) {
      const row = candidates[i];
      if (row.currency) changed += addCurrency(root, row.amount, row.type);
      if (row.item) changed += grantItem(root, row.item, "v124_inventory_fast");
    }
    changed += applyEquipFromOutput(root, rawText);

    if (changed > 0) changed += compactOwnedItemDuplicates(root);
    return { handled: changed > 0, changed: changed };
  }

  function ensureAbility(root, name, tags, meaning) {
    if (!name) return 0;
    if (A.AbilitySystem && typeof A.AbilitySystem.init === "function") {
      try { A.AbilitySystem.init(root); } catch (_error) {}
    }
    root.abilities = root.abilities || {};
    const abilities = root.abilities;
    abilities.byId = abilities.byId || {};
    abilities.byKey = abilities.byKey || {};
    abilities.allIds = Array.isArray(abilities.allIds) ? abilities.allIds : [];
    abilities.skillIds = Array.isArray(abilities.skillIds) ? abilities.skillIds : [];
    abilities.recentEvents = Array.isArray(abilities.recentEvents) ? abilities.recentEvents : [];

    const normalized = key(name);
    const id = abilities.byKey[normalized] || "skill_" + normalized;
    let record = abilities.byId[id];
    if (!record) {
      record = abilities.byId[id] = {
        identity: { id: id, name: name, type: "skill" },
        keys: { normalizedName: normalized, aliases: [], keyPhrases: [name] },
        meaning: {
          originContext: "v124 fast ability support",
          intendedFunction: meaning || "bounded ability use",
          stableMeaningFlags: ["bounded", "confirmed"],
          emergentApplications: []
        },
        progression: {
          tier: 1,
          xp: 1,
          useCount: 0,
          trainingCount: 0,
          masteryState: "novice",
          lastConfirmedTurn: root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0,
          lastUsedTurn: root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0
        },
        observation: {
          confidence: 0.8,
          lastEvidence: name,
          notes: [],
          observedFunctions: [],
          semanticTags: tags || []
        },
        source: { sourceIntentType: "v124_fast", sourceTags: tags || [] }
      };
      abilities.byKey[normalized] = id;
      pushUnique(abilities.allIds, id, 80);
      pushUnique(abilities.skillIds, id, 80);
    }
    record.progression = record.progression || {};
    record.progression.useCount = (Number(record.progression.useCount) || 0) + 1;
    record.progression.lastUsedTurn = root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0;
    record.observation = record.observation || {};
    record.observation.lastEvidence = name;
    if (Array.isArray(tags)) {
      record.observation.semanticTags = Array.isArray(record.observation.semanticTags) ? record.observation.semanticTags : [];
      for (let i = 0; i < tags.length; i += 1) pushUnique(record.observation.semanticTags, tags[i], 20);
    }
    abilities.recentEvents.push({
      turn: root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0,
      name: name,
      kind: "use",
      text: name
    });
    while (abilities.recentEvents.length > 20) abilities.recentEvents.shift();
    if (root.meta && root.meta.dirty && Array.isArray(root.meta.dirty.abilities)) pushUnique(root.meta.dirty.abilities, id, 60);
    if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") A.Utils.invalidatePackets(root);
    return 1;
  }

  function applyAbilityInputFast(root, rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const match = raw.match(/\b(?:use|cast|channel|invoke|activate|practice|train)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{2,40}?)(?:\s+(?:on|at|against|toward|to)\b|\.|,|$)/);
    if (!match) return 0;
    const abilityName = text(match[1]).replace(/\s+(?:on|at|against|toward|to)$/i, "");
    if (!abilityName) return 0;
    root.pending = root.pending || {};
    root.pending.abilityCandidate = {
      name: abilityName,
      source: "v124_use_ability_input",
      confidence: 0.9,
      tags: ["use_ability"]
    };
    if (root.pending.inputIntent && typeof root.pending.inputIntent === "object") {
      root.pending.inputIntent.primaryType = "use_ability";
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function applyAbilityOutputFast(root, rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const s = lower(raw);
    let changed = 0;
    if (/\bfirecat\b/i.test(raw) && /\bcard\b/i.test(raw)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Firecat", ["card_magic", "fire", "novice", "bounded"], "beginner card spell that lightly burns and drains mana");
    }
    if (/\btower\s+shield\b/i.test(raw) && /\bcard\b/i.test(raw)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Tower Shield", ["card_magic", "shield", "defense", "novice"], "beginner defensive card spell");
    }
    if (/\bfire\s+dragon\s+roar\b/i.test(raw)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Fire Dragon Roar", ["anime_magic", "fire", "draining", "bounded"], "unstable beginner cone of flame that drains mana");
      const stats = root.player && root.player.stats;
      if (stats && typeof stats.mp === "number") stats.mp = Math.max(0, stats.mp - 3);
    }
    if (/\bearth\s+control\b/i.test(raw)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Earth Control", ["earth", "magic", "control"], "earth manipulation and stone shaping");
    }
    if (/\bflame\s+lance\b/i.test(raw)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Flame Lance", ["fire", "projectile", "attack"], "fire attack ability");
    }
    if (/\bember\s+ward\b/i.test(raw)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Ember Ward", ["fire", "defense", "ward"], "defensive ember ward");
      const ability = root.abilities && root.abilities.byId && root.abilities.byId[root.abilities.byKey && root.abilities.byKey.ember_ward];
      if (ability && /\blow\s+ember\s+dome|\blow\s+dome|\bdome\b/i.test(raw)) {
        ability.meaning = ability.meaning || {};
        ability.meaning.emergentApplications = Array.isArray(ability.meaning.emergentApplications) ? ability.meaning.emergentApplications : [];
        pushUnique(ability.meaning.emergentApplications, "low ember dome defensive application", 12);
      }
      // Hard negative: do not learn Ember Blade from shared Ember wording.
      if (root.abilities && root.abilities.byId) {
        for (const id of Object.keys(root.abilities.byId)) {
          if (/ember_blade|low_dome/i.test(id) || /\bember\s+blade\b/i.test(text(root.abilities.byId[id].identity && root.abilities.byId[id].identity.name))) {
            delete root.abilities.byId[id];
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (/\bslime\b/.test(s) && /\babsorbs?\b/.test(s) && /\bherb\b/.test(s) && /\bsoothing\s+gel|trace|faint\b/.test(s)) {
      changed += ensureAbility(root, "Faint Soothing Gel", ["slime", "absorption", "healing_herb", "minor_passive"], "minor slime herb adaptation");
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function applyExplicitXp(root, rawText) {
    const match = text(rawText).match(/\bgain(?:s|ed)?\s+(\d{1,6})\s+XP\b/i);
    if (!match) return 0;
    const amount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(match[1]) || 0));
    if (!amount) return 0;
    root.player = root.player || {};
    root.player.levelState = root.player.levelState || { level: 1, xp: 0, totalXp: 0, xpToNext: 100 };
    const ls = root.player.levelState;
    const opKey = (root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0) + "|xp|" + hash(rawText) + "|" + amount;
    root.pending = root.pending || {};
    root.pending.v124XpKeys = Array.isArray(root.pending.v124XpKeys) ? root.pending.v124XpKeys : [];
    if (root.pending.v124XpKeys.indexOf(opKey) !== -1) return 0;
    root.pending.v124XpKeys.push(opKey);
    while (root.pending.v124XpKeys.length > 40) root.pending.v124XpKeys.shift();
    ls.xp = (Number(ls.xp) || 0) + amount;
    ls.totalXp = (Number(ls.totalXp) || 0) + amount;
    if (!ls.xpToNext) ls.xpToNext = 100;
    if (root.meta && root.meta.dirty) root.meta.dirty.player = true;
    return 1;
  }

  function applyFailedPurchase(root, rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const match = raw.match(/\b(?:do\s+not|don't|does\s+not|doesn't|did\s+not|didn't|not\s+enough|insufficient|cannot|can't)\b[^.!?]{0,90}\b(?:money|silver|gold|copper|coins?|funds|afford)\b[^.!?]{0,90}\b(?:for|to\s+buy|purchase|afford)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.!?;,]+)/i);
    if (!match) return 0;
    ensureInventory(root);
    const item = cleanItemPhrase(match[1]) || "purchase";
    root.items.failedPurchases = Array.isArray(root.items.failedPurchases) ? root.items.failedPurchases : [];
    pushUnique(root.items.failedPurchases, item, 12);
    softLog(root, "Purchase failed: not enough funds for " + item + ".");
    return 1;
  }

  function ensureActorMemory(root) {
    root.actors = root.actors || {};
    root.actors.majorMemory = root.actors.majorMemory || {};
    const memory = root.actors.majorMemory;
    memory.byActorId = memory.byActorId || {};
    memory.activeIds = Array.isArray(memory.activeIds) ? memory.activeIds : [];
    memory.recentEvents = Array.isArray(memory.recentEvents) ? memory.recentEvents : [];
    return memory;
  }

  function actorMemory(root, name, note, kind) {
    const cleanName = text(name).replace(/^(?:the|a|an)\s+/i, "").replace(/\s+(?:now|currently|usually|often|still)$/i, "");
    if (!cleanName || /^(?:she|he|they|it|her|him|them)$/i.test(cleanName)) return 0;
    const memory = ensureActorMemory(root);
    const id = "mem_" + key(cleanName);
    const rec = memory.byActorId[id] || (memory.byActorId[id] = {
      actorId: id,
      id: id,
      name: cleanName,
      relationshipStance: "neutral",
      attitudeNotes: [],
      goals: [],
      grudges: [],
      conditions: [],
      transactions: [],
      stateTags: [],
      lastSeenTurn: 0,
      lastUpdatedTurn: 0
    });
    rec.lastSeenTurn = root.meta && typeof root.meta.currentTurn === "number" ? root.meta.currentTurn : 0;
    rec.lastUpdatedTurn = rec.lastSeenTurn;
    pushUnique(rec.attitudeNotes, note, 10);
    pushUnique(memory.activeIds, id, 20);
    memory.recentEvents.push({ turn: rec.lastUpdatedTurn, name: cleanName, actorId: id, kind: kind || "memory", text: note });
    while (memory.recentEvents.length > 20) memory.recentEvents.shift();
    return 1;
  }

  function applyActorFast(root, rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    let changed = 0;
    let match = raw.match(/\b(Seren|Mira|Talla|Bram|Captain\s+Dorne)\b[^.!?]{0,100}\b(?:trusts?|thanks?|follows?|accompanies?|wounded|injured|hands?|gives?|sells?|trades?)\b[^.!?]{0,120}/i);
    if (match) changed += actorMemory(root, match[1], raw.slice(0, 160), "actor_update");
    match = raw.match(/\b(ancient\s+dragon|stone\s+golem|ash\s+wolf|black\s+bear)\b[^.!?]{0,160}\b(?:wary|mercy|damaged|guards?|limps?|wounded|remembers?)\b[^.!?]{0,120}/i);
    if (match) changed += actorMemory(root, match[1].toLowerCase(), raw.slice(0, 160), "creature_state");
    return changed;
  }

  function applyWorldFast(root, rawText) {
    const raw = text(rawText);
    const lowerRaw = lower(raw);
    let changed = 0;
    if (/\bpoison\s+(?:the\s+)?village\s+well\b|\bvillage\s+well\s+is\s+poisoned\b/.test(lowerRaw)) {
      root.world = root.world || {};
      root.world.structure = root.world.structure || { nodesById: {}, dirtyNodeIds: [], recentStructureEvents: [] };
      const structure = root.world.structure;
      structure.nodesById = structure.nodesById || {};
      structure.dirtyNodeIds = Array.isArray(structure.dirtyNodeIds) ? structure.dirtyNodeIds : [];
      const id = "ws_structure_world_village_well";
      const node = structure.nodesById[id] || (structure.nodesById[id] = {
        id: id,
        name: "village well",
        displayName: "village well",
        kind: "structure",
        conditionTags: [],
        source: "v124"
      });
      node.conditionTags = Array.isArray(node.conditionTags) ? node.conditionTags : [];
      pushUnique(node.conditionTags, "poisoned", 12);
      pushUnique(node.conditionTags, "public_crime", 12);
      pushUnique(structure.dirtyNodeIds, id, 60);
      root.reputation = root.reputation || {};
      root.reputation.bySubject = root.reputation.bySubject || {};
      const rep = root.reputation.bySubject.local_authorities || (root.reputation.bySubject.local_authorities = {
        identity: { displayName: "local authorities" },
        mutable: { score: 0, standing: "neutral", tags: [] }
      });
      rep.mutable = rep.mutable || { score: 0, standing: "neutral", tags: [] };
      rep.mutable.score = Math.min(Number(rep.mutable.score) || 0, -25);
      rep.mutable.standing = "hostile";
      rep.mutable.tags = Array.isArray(rep.mutable.tags) ? rep.mutable.tags : [];
      pushUnique(rep.mutable.tags, "criminal", 12);
      pushUnique(rep.mutable.tags, "poisoned_well", 12);
      pushUnique(rep.mutable.tags, "guards_panic", 12);
      changed += 1;
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function storyCardArrays() {
    const arrays = [];
    try { if (Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards)) arrays.push(globalThis.storyCards); } catch (_error) {}
    try { if (globalThis.storyCards && Array.isArray(globalThis.storyCards.cards)) arrays.push(globalThis.storyCards.cards); } catch (_error) {}
    try { if (typeof storyCards !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(storyCards)) arrays.push(storyCards); } catch (_error) {}
    try { if (globalThis.info && Array.isArray(info.storyCards)) arrays.push(info.storyCards); } catch (_error) {}
    try { if (globalThis.info && info.storyCards && Array.isArray(info.storyCards.cards)) arrays.push(info.storyCards.cards); } catch (_error) {}
    return arrays;
  }

  function cardText(card) {
    return text([
      card && card.title,
      card && card.name,
      card && card.keys,
      card && card.key,
      card && card.entry,
      card && card.text,
      card && card.description
    ].join(" "));
  }

  function managedCardKey(card) {
    const combined = cardText(card);
    const namespace = combined.match(/\bSYS:AIDRPG:[A-Z0-9_]+:[A-Z0-9_]+\b/i);
    if (namespace) return namespace[0].toUpperCase();
    const low = lower(combined);
    if (/\b(?:copper\s+hart|burned\s+tavern|sealed\s+tavern|barricaded\s+tavern|charred\s+roof)\b/.test(low)) return "TAVERN:COPPER_HART_CLUSTER";
    if (/\bmira\b/.test(low) && /\b(?:trust|companion|wound|follow)\b/.test(low)) return "ACTOR:MIRA_CLUSTER";
    if (/\bcaptain\s+dorne\b/.test(low)) return "ACTOR:CAPTAIN_DORNE_CLUSTER";
    return "";
  }

  function isManagedOrDuplicatePressureCard(card) {
    const combined = cardText(card);
    return Boolean(
      card && card.aidrpgManaged === true ||
      /\bSYS:AIDRPG\b/i.test(combined) ||
      /\b(?:copper\s+hart|burned\s+tavern|sealed\s+tavern|barricaded\s+tavern|charred\s+roof)\b/i.test(combined)
    );
  }

  function compactManagedStoryCards(root) {
    let changed = 0;
    const arrays = storyCardArrays();
    for (let a = 0; a < arrays.length; a += 1) {
      const cards = arrays[a];
      const keep = [];
      const seen = Object.create(null);
      let managedCount = 0;
      const scanLimit = Math.min(cards.length, 260);
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i += 1) {
        const card = cards[i];
        if (i >= scanLimit) {
          keep.push(card);
          continue;
        }
        if (!isManagedOrDuplicatePressureCard(card)) {
          keep.push(card);
          continue;
        }
        const cardKey = managedCardKey(card) || key(cardText(card)).slice(0, 80);
        if (seen[cardKey]) {
          changed += 1;
          continue;
        }
        seen[cardKey] = true;
        managedCount += 1;
        keep.push(card);
      }
      // Only reduce duplicate/managed pressure; never globally cap unrelated player cards.
      for (let i = keep.length - 1; i >= 0 && managedCount > 12; i -= 1) {
        if (isManagedOrDuplicatePressureCard(keep[i])) {
          keep.splice(i, 1);
          managedCount -= 1;
          changed += 1;
        }
      }
      if (keep.length !== cards.length) cards.splice(0, cards.length, ...keep);
    }

    if (root && root.cards) {
      const queueNames = ["dirtyQueue", "pendingWrites", "dryRunLog", "recentOperations", "duplicateRefs"];
      for (let i = 0; i < queueNames.length; i += 1) {
        const name = queueNames[i];
        if (!Array.isArray(root.cards[name])) continue;
        if (root.cards[name].length > 18) {
          root.cards[name] = root.cards[name].slice(-18);
          changed += 1;
        }
      }
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function sanitizeContextText(value) {
    return String(value || "")
      .replace(/\bSYS:AIDRPG:[A-Z0-9_:]+\b/g, "managed canon")
      .replace(/\b(?:location|entity|actor|item|route|ws)_[a-z0-9_]+\b/g, function (match) {
        return match.replace(/^(?:location|entity|actor|item|route|ws)_/, "").replace(/_/g, " ");
      })
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim();
  }

  function runStandardOutputSystems(rawText, root) {
    const sequence = [
      ["ConsequenceParser", "processOutput"],
      ["ValidationSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["PlayerSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["SceneStateSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["WorldEntitySystem", "processOutput"],
      ["TimeTravelSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["ReputationSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["QuestLogSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["InventorySystem", "processOutput"],
      ["ProgressionSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["AbilitySystem", "processOutput"],
      ["PersistentTraitSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["SpecializationSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["ActorProfileSystem", "processOutput"],
      ["MajorActorMemorySystem", "processOutput"]
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < sequence.length; i += 1) {
      const system = A[sequence[i][0]];
      const method = sequence[i][1];
      try {
        if (system && typeof system[method] === "function") system[method](rawText, root);
      } catch (error) {
        softLog(root, "Output fail-soft: " + sequence[i][0]);
      }
    }
    // CardSync is deliberately not part of the hot-path chain. It is compacted below.
  }

  function processFastOutput(rawText, root) {
    const minutes = parseDurationMinutes(rawText);
    if (shouldFastApplyTime(rawText) && minutes) {
      const timeApplied = applyTimeMinutes(root, rawText, minutes);
      if (timeApplied) addRouteMemory(root, rawText, minutes);
      return { handled: true, fastOnly: true };
    }

    const inventory = applyInventoryFast(root, rawText);
    const abilityChange = applyAbilityOutputFast(root, rawText);
    const xpChange = applyExplicitXp(root, rawText);
    const failedPurchaseChange = applyFailedPurchase(root, rawText);
    const actorChange = applyActorFast(root, rawText);
    const worldChange = applyWorldFast(root, rawText);

    const dangerousFastOnly =
      isDialogueOnlyAcquisition(rawText) ||
      isNegativeAcquisition(rawText) ||
      isNoItemSearch(rawText) ||
      /\bfire\s+dragon\s+roar\b/i.test(rawText) ||
      /\btrip\b[^.!?]{0,60}\btakes?\s+[^.!?]{1,40}\bweeks?\b/i.test(rawText) ||
      /\bpoison\s+(?:the\s+)?village\s+well\b/i.test(rawText);

    return {
      handled: dangerousFastOnly || inventory.handled || abilityChange > 0 || xpChange > 0 || failedPurchaseChange > 0 || actorChange > 0 || worldChange > 0,
      fastOnly: dangerousFastOnly || inventory.handled || abilityChange > 0 || xpChange > 0 || failedPurchaseChange > 0
    };
  }

  // Keep CardSync callable, but replace heavy final wrappers with bounded compaction.
  if (A.CardSyncSystem) {
    A.CardSyncSystem.compactManagedStoryCards = function compactManagedStoryCardsPublic(root) {
      return compactManagedStoryCards(root || state.aidrpg);
    };
    A.CardSyncSystem.processOutput = function processOutputBounded(rawText, root) {
      return compactManagedStoryCards(root || state.aidrpg);
    };
    A.CardSyncSystem.processContext = function processContextBounded(rawText, root) {
      return 0;
    };
    A.CardSyncSystem.processDirtyQueue = function processDirtyQueueBounded(root) {
      return compactManagedStoryCards(root || state.aidrpg);
    };
  }

  A.onInput = function onInputV124(textValue) {
    const runtime = this.RuntimeGate.validate("input", textValue);
    if (!runtime.ok) return this.RuntimeGate.failSoft("input", runtime, textValue);
    const root = initializeForHook(false);
    const rawText = runtime.text;
    this.TurnEngine.beginHook("input", rawText);
    try {
      const commandResult = this.AdminDebugSystem.handleCommand(rawText);
      if (commandResult) {
        state.aidrpg.pending.inputIntent = null;
        state.aidrpg.pending.abilityCandidate = null;
        return commandResult;
      }
      if (this.IntentParser && typeof this.IntentParser.parseInput === "function") this.IntentParser.parseInput(rawText);
      applyAbilityInputFast(root, rawText);
      if (this.AbilitySystem && typeof this.AbilitySystem.processInput === "function") this.AbilitySystem.processInput(rawText);
      if (this.TimeTravelSystem && typeof this.TimeTravelSystem.processInput === "function") this.TimeTravelSystem.processInput(rawText);
      return { text: rawText };
    } finally {
      this.TurnEngine.endHook("input", rawText);
    }
  };

  A.onContext = function onContextV124(textValue) {
    const runtime = this.RuntimeGate.validate("context", textValue);
    if (!runtime.ok) return this.RuntimeGate.failSoft("context", runtime, textValue);
    const root = initializeForHook(true);
    const rawText = runtime.text;
    this.TurnEngine.beginHook("context", rawText);
    try {
      let contextText = rawText;
      if (this.ContextPacketSystem && typeof this.ContextPacketSystem.buildContext === "function") {
        contextText = this.ContextPacketSystem.buildContext(rawText);
      }
      return { text: sanitizeContextText(contextText) };
    } finally {
      this.TurnEngine.endHook("context", rawText);
    }
  };

  A.onOutput = function onOutputV124(textValue) {
    const runtime = this.RuntimeGate.validate("output", textValue);
    if (!runtime.ok) return this.RuntimeGate.failSoft("output", runtime, textValue);
    const root = initializeForHook(true);
    const rawText = runtime.text;
    this.TurnEngine.beginHook("output", rawText);
    let result = { text: rawText };
    try {
      const fast = processFastOutput(rawText, root);
      if (!fast.fastOnly) {
        runStandardOutputSystems(rawText, root);
        // Post-run assurance for edge cases the older systems may miss or overwrite.
        applyInventoryFast(root, rawText);
        applyAbilityOutputFast(root, rawText);
        applyExplicitXp(root, rawText);
        applyFailedPurchase(root, rawText);
        applyActorFast(root, rawText);
        applyWorldFast(root, rawText);
      }
      compactOwnedItemDuplicates(root);
      compactManagedStoryCards(root);
      return result;
    } finally {
      const finalText = result && typeof result.text === "string" ? result.text : rawText;
      this.TurnEngine.endHook("output", finalText);
    }
  };

  A.VERSION = FINAL_VERSION;
  A.BUILD_STAGE = FINAL_STAGE;
  A.__aidrpg125FinalRelease = true;
})(globalThis.AIDRPG);

/* ============================================================================
 * AIDRPG v1.2.6 final stabilization patch
 * Focus: replay-safe item grants, route memory phrasing, dirty ability context,
 * scene reinforcement, and dungeon strict-detail preservation.
 * This patch is readable and bounded; it does not run Story Card scans on Input.
 * ========================================================================== */
;(function installAIDRPG126(A) {
  "use strict";
  if (!A || A.__aidrpg126FinalRelease) return;
  const FINAL_VERSION = "1.2.6-production";
  const FINAL_STAGE = "AIDRPG-v1.2.6-final-release";
  function str(value) { return String(value == null ? "" : value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); }
  function low(value) { return str(value).toLowerCase(); }
  function makeKey(value) {
    if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.toKey === "function") return A.Utils.toKey(value);
    return low(value).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
  }
  function hash(value) {
    const text = String(value == null ? "" : value);
    let h = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) { h ^= text.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); }
    return (h >>> 0).toString(36);
  }
  const NUMBER_WORDS = { a:1, an:1, one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10, eleven:11, twelve:12, thirteen:13, fourteen:14, fifteen:15, sixteen:16, seventeen:17, eighteen:18, nineteen:19, twenty:20, thirty:30, forty:40, fifty:50, sixty:60, ninety:90 };
  function numberFrom(value) {
    const clean = low(value).replace(/-/g, " ");
    if (/^\d+$/.test(clean)) return Number(clean);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(NUMBER_WORDS, clean)) return NUMBER_WORDS[clean];
    const parts = clean.split(/\s+/); let total = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i += 1) total += NUMBER_WORDS[parts[i]] || 0;
    return total || 0;
  }

    s = s.replace(/\b(?:before|after|while|because|when)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "");
    s = s.replace(/\s+from\s+(?:the\s+)?[^.!?,;]{1,80}$/i, "");
    return cleanSpaces(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  function playerItemIds(root) {
    const items = root.items || {};
    const owned = items.ownership && Array.isArray(items.ownership.player) ? items.ownership.player : [];
    return owned;
  }

  function removeItemRecord(root, id) {
    if (!id || !root.items) return 0;
    let changed = 0;
    const items = root.items;
    if (items.byId && items.byId[id]) {
      delete items.byId[id];
      changed += 1;
    }
    if (items.ownership && Array.isArray(items.ownership.player)) {
      const next = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < items.ownership.player.length; i += 1) {
        if (items.ownership.player[i] !== id) next.push(items.ownership.player[i]);
        else changed += 1;
      }
      items.ownership.player = next;
    }
    if (items.equipment && typeof items.equipment === "object") {
      const slots = Object.keys(items.equipment);
      for (let i = 0; i < slots.length; i += 1) {
        if (items.equipment[slots[i]] === id) {
          items.equipment[slots[i]] = null;
          changed += 1;
        }
      }
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function mergeItemRecords(keep, drop) {
    if (!keep || !drop) return;
    try {
      if (drop.condition && Array.isArray(drop.condition.stateTags)) {
        if (!keep.condition || typeof keep.condition !== "object") keep.condition = { durability: 100, stateTags: [] };
        if (!Array.isArray(keep.condition.stateTags)) keep.condition.stateTags = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < drop.condition.stateTags.length; i += 1) {
          const tag = drop.condition.stateTags[i];
          if (tag && keep.condition.stateTags.indexOf(tag) === -1) keep.condition.stateTags.push(tag);
        }
      }
      if (drop.notes && Array.isArray(drop.notes.observedChanges)) {
        if (!keep.notes || typeof keep.notes !== "object") keep.notes = {};
        if (!Array.isArray(keep.notes.observedChanges)) keep.notes.observedChanges = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < drop.notes.observedChanges.length && keep.notes.observedChanges.length < 12; i += 1) {
          keep.notes.observedChanges.push(drop.notes.observedChanges[i]);
        }
      }
    } catch (_error) {}
  }

  function compactOwnedItems(root) {
    if (!root || !root.items || !root.items.byId) return 0;
    const items = root.items;
    if (!items.ownership || typeof items.ownership !== "object") items.ownership = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(items.ownership.player)) items.ownership.player = [];

    let changed = 0;
    const seen = Object.create(null);
    const next = [];
    const ids = items.ownership.player.slice(0, 240);

    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 1) {
      const id = ids[i];
      const rec = items.byId[id];
      if (!rec) { changed += 1; continue; }
      const display = cleanSpaces(rec.displayName || rec.name || id);
      const norm = normalizeItemName(display);
      if (!norm || isPronounActionFragment(display) || /^(?:and|place it|put it|stash it|slip it|tuck it|it in your pouch|it in your bag)$/.test(norm)) {
        changed += removeItemRecord(root, id);
        continue;
      }
      const key = norm;
      if (seen[key]) {
        const keep = items.byId[seen[key]];
        mergeItemRecords(keep, rec);
        changed += removeItemRecord(root, id);
        continue;
      }
      seen[key] = id;
      next.push(id);
    }

    if (items.ownership.player.join("|") !== next.join("|")) {
      items.ownership.player = next;
      changed += 1;
    }

    return changed;
  }

  function ensureItem(root, displayName, source, extra) {
    if (!displayName) return null;
    if (!root.items || typeof root.items !== "object") root.items = {};
    const items = root.items;
    if (!items.byId || typeof items.byId !== "object") items.byId = {};
    if (!items.ownership || typeof items.ownership !== "object") items.ownership = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(items.ownership.player)) items.ownership.player = [];
    const norm = normalizeItemName(displayName);
    if (!norm || isPronounActionFragment(norm)) return null;
    let id = "item_" + toKey(norm);
    let rec = items.byId[id];
    if (!rec) {
      rec = items.byId[id] = {
        id,
        displayName: displayName,
        baseType: norm.split(" ").slice(-1)[0] || "item",
        category: "item",
        state: "packed",
        source: source || "v127_final",
        notes: { sourceContext: source || "v127_final", observedChanges: [] },
        descriptors: [],
        materialTags: [],
        quality: "",
        condition: { durability: 100, stateTags: [] },
        slot: "",
        stackable: false,
        quantity: 1,
        stats: {},
        ownership: { holder: "player", visibility: "packed" }
      };
    }
    if (extra && typeof extra === "object") {
      if (extra.state) rec.state = extra.state;
      if (extra.category) rec.category = extra.category;
      if (extra.visibility) {
        rec.ownership = rec.ownership || {};
        rec.ownership.visibility = extra.visibility;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(extra.tags)) {
        if (!rec.condition || typeof rec.condition !== "object") rec.condition = { durability: 100, stateTags: [] };
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.condition.stateTags)) rec.condition.stateTags = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < extra.tags.length; i += 1) {
          if (rec.condition.stateTags.indexOf(extra.tags[i]) === -1) rec.condition.stateTags.push(extra.tags[i]);
        }
      }
      if (extra.note) {
        rec.notes = rec.notes || {};
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.notes.observedChanges)) rec.notes.observedChanges = [];
        rec.notes.observedChanges.push({ turn: root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0, text: String(extra.note).slice(0, 180) });
        while (rec.notes.observedChanges.length > 12) rec.notes.observedChanges.shift();
      }
    }
    if (items.ownership.player.indexOf(id) === -1) items.ownership.player.push(id);
    markDirty(root, "items", id);
    return rec;
  }

  // Inventory parser hardening: block pronoun-action fragments before they can become item candidates.
  if (A.InventorySystem && !A.InventorySystem.__aidrpg127InventoryHardening) {
    const I = A.InventorySystem;
    const oldClean = I.cleanItemPhrase;
    const oldSplit = I.splitAcquisitionCapture;
    const oldExtract = I.extractAcquisitionPhrases;

    I.cleanItemPhrase = function aidrpg127CleanItemPhrase(value) {
      if (isPronounActionFragment(value)) return "";
      const stripped = stripPronounFollowup(value);
      if (isPronounActionFragment(stripped)) return "";
      const out = oldClean ? oldClean.call(this, stripped) : stripped;
      return isPronounActionFragment(out) ? "" : out;
    };

    I.splitAcquisitionCapture = function aidrpg127SplitAcquisitionCapture(value) {
      const stripped = stripPronounFollowup(value);
      const rawPieces = oldSplit ? oldSplit.call(this, stripped) : [stripped];
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < rawPieces.length && out.length < 8; i += 1) {
        const piece = cleanSpaces(rawPieces[i]);
        if (!piece || isPronounActionFragment(piece)) continue;
        const cleaned = this.cleanItemPhrase ? this.cleanItemPhrase(piece) : piece;
        if (cleaned && !isPronounActionFragment(cleaned)) out.push(cleaned);
      }
      return out;
    };

    I.extractAcquisitionPhrases = function aidrpg127ExtractAcquisitionPhrases(textValue, root) {
      const raw = textOf(textValue);
      let phrases = oldExtract ? oldExtract.call(this, raw, root) || [] : [];
      const out = [];
      const seen = Object.create(null);
      for (let i = 0; i < phrases.length && out.length < 10; i += 1) {
        const rawPhrase = phrases[i];
        if (isPronounActionFragment(rawPhrase)) continue;
        const cleaned = this.cleanItemPhrase ? this.cleanItemPhrase(rawPhrase) : stripPronounFollowup(rawPhrase);
        if (!cleaned || isPronounActionFragment(cleaned)) continue;
        const norm = normalizeItemName(cleaned);
        if (!norm || seen[norm]) continue;
        seen[norm] = true;
        out.push(cleaned);
      }
      return out;
    };

    I.__aidrpg127InventoryHardening = true;
  }

  function detectConsumedHealingVial(root, rawText) {
    const raw = textOf(rawText);
    const s = lower(raw);
    if (!/\b(?:minor\s+healing\s+vial|healing\s+vial|vial)\b/.test(s)) return 0;
    if (!/\b(?:drink|drank|use|used|consume|consumed|dulls?|dull|treat|treats|treated|cure|cures|cured|healing)\b/.test(s)) return 0;
    const name = /\bminor\s+healing\s+vial\b/i.test(raw) ? "minor healing vial" : "healing vial";
    const rec = ensureItem(root, name, "v127_consumed_item_evidence", { state: "used", visibility: "used", tags: ["used", "healing", "vial"], note: raw });
    return rec ? 1 : 0;
  }

  function parseMinutesNumber(word) {
    const w = lower(word);
    if (/^\d+$/.test(w)) return parseInt(w, 10);
    const map = { one: 1, two: 2, three: 3, four: 4, five: 5, six: 6, seven: 7, eight: 8, nine: 9, ten: 10, eleven: 11, twelve: 12 };
    return map[w] || 0;
  }

  function routeKey(from, to) {
    const a = cleanSpaces(from);
    const b = cleanSpaces(to);
    return "route_" + toKey(a) + "__" + toKey(b);
  }

  function setRouteDelay(root, from, to, baseMinutes, actualMinutes, reason, rawText) {
    if (!from || !to || !baseMinutes) return 0;
    if (!root.time || typeof root.time !== "object") root.time = {};
    if (!root.time.routes || typeof root.time.routes !== "object") root.time.routes = {};
    if (!root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes || typeof root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes !== "object") root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes = {};
    const table = root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes;
    const pairs = [[from, to], [to, from]];
    for (let i = 0; i < pairs.length; i += 1) {
      const k = routeKey(pairs[i][0], pairs[i][1]);
      const rec = table[k] || { fromRef: pairs[i][0], toRef: pairs[i][1], minutes: baseMinutes, symmetric: true };
      rec.fromRef = pairs[i][0];
      rec.toRef = pairs[i][1];
      rec.minutes = baseMinutes;
      rec.baseMinutes = baseMinutes;
      rec.lastActualMinutes = actualMinutes || baseMinutes;
      rec.lastDelayMinutes = Math.max(0, (actualMinutes || baseMinutes) - baseMinutes);
      rec.lastDelayReason = reason || rec.lastDelayReason || "";
      rec.lastRouteNote = cleanSpaces(rawText).slice(0, 180);
      rec.lastConfirmedTurn = root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0;
      rec.symmetric = true;
      table[k] = rec;
    }
    markDirty(root, "routes", routeKey(from, to));
    return 1;
  }

  function detectRouteDelay(root, rawText) {
    const raw = cleanSpaces(rawText);
    let m = raw.match(/\b(?:because\s+of\s+([^,.;!?]{2,60}),?\s*)?(?:the\s+)?(?:return|trip|journey|route|road|crossing|voyage)\s+from\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,50})\s+to\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z' -]{1,60})\s+takes?\s+(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve)\s+hours?\s+instead\s+of\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:usual\s+)?(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve)\s+hours?\b/i);
    if (!m) return 0;
    const reason = cleanSpaces(m[1] || "delay");
    const from = cleanSpaces(m[2]);
    const to = cleanSpaces(m[3]);
    const actual = parseMinutesNumber(m[4]) * 60;
    const base = parseMinutesNumber(m[5]) * 60;
    return setRouteDelay(root, from, to, base, actual, reason, raw);
  }

  function ensureEmberWard(root, rawText) {
    const raw = textOf(rawText);
    if (!/\bEmber\s+Ward\b/i.test(raw)) return 0;
    if (!root.abilities || typeof root.abilities !== "object") root.abilities = {};
    const abilities = root.abilities;
    if (!abilities.byId || typeof abilities.byId !== "object") abilities.byId = {};
    if (!abilities.byKey || typeof abilities.byKey !== "object") abilities.byKey = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(abilities.allIds)) abilities.allIds = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(abilities.skillIds)) abilities.skillIds = [];
    const id = abilities.byKey.ember_ward || "skill_ember_ward";
    let rec = abilities.byId[id];
    if (!rec) {
      rec = abilities.byId[id] = {
        identity: { id, name: "Ember Ward", type: "skill" },
        keys: { normalizedName: "ember_ward", aliases: [], keyPhrases: ["Ember Ward"] },
        meaning: { originContext: "v127 final ability reinforcement", intendedFunction: "defensive ember ward that protects the user and allies", stableMeaningFlags: ["bounded", "confirmed"], emergentApplications: [] },
        progression: { tier: 1, xp: 0, useCount: 0, trainingCount: 0, masteryState: "novice", lastConfirmedTurn: 0, lastUsedTurn: 0 },
        observation: { confidence: 0.75, lastEvidence: "", notes: [], observedFunctions: [], semanticTags: [] },
        source: { sourceIntentType: "v127_final", sourceTags: [] }
      };
      abilities.byKey.ember_ward = id;
      if (abilities.allIds.indexOf(id) === -1) abilities.allIds.push(id);
      if (abilities.skillIds.indexOf(id) === -1) abilities.skillIds.push(id);
    }
    rec.identity = rec.identity || { id, name: "Ember Ward", type: "skill" };
    rec.keys = rec.keys || { normalizedName: "ember_ward", aliases: [], keyPhrases: [] };
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases)) rec.keys.keyPhrases = [];
    if (rec.keys.keyPhrases.indexOf("Ember Ward") === -1) rec.keys.keyPhrases.push("Ember Ward");
    rec.meaning = rec.meaning || {};
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications)) rec.meaning.emergentApplications = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags)) rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags = [];
    rec.observation = rec.observation || {};
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags)) rec.observation.semanticTags = [];
    rec.progression = rec.progression || {};
    rec.progression.useCount = Number(rec.progression.useCount || 0) + 1;
    rec.progression.lastConfirmedTurn = root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || rec.progression.lastConfirmedTurn || 0;
    rec.progression.lastUsedTurn = rec.progression.lastConfirmedTurn;
    rec.observation.lastEvidence = raw.slice(0, 220);
    const add = (arr, value) => { if (arr.indexOf(value) === -1) arr.push(value); };
    ["fire", "defense", "ward", "protection", "team", "allies", "ally_protection", "protect_allies"].forEach(t => add(rec.observation.semanticTags, t));
    if (/\bdome\b/i.test(raw)) add(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, "team-covering ember dome");
    if (/\bteam|allies|ally|whole team\b/i.test(raw)) add(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, "defensive Ember Ward that shields the whole team");
    add(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags, "bounded");
    add(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags, "confirmed");
    abilities.__v127PriorityAbilityKey = "ember_ward";
    markDirty(root, "abilities", id);
    return 1;
  }

  function emberPriorityLine(root) {
    const abilities = root && root.abilities || {};
    const id = abilities.byKey && (abilities.byKey.ember_ward || abilities.byKey[abilities.__v127PriorityAbilityKey]);
    const rec = id && abilities.byId ? abilities.byId[id] : null;
    if (!rec) return "";
    const tags = [];
    const sem = rec.observation && Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags) ? rec.observation.semanticTags : [];
    const apps = rec.meaning && Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications) ? rec.meaning.emergentApplications : [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sem.length && tags.length < 8; i += 1) if (tags.indexOf(sem[i]) === -1) tags.push(sem[i]);
    for (let i = 0; i < apps.length && tags.length < 12; i += 1) if (tags.indexOf(apps[i]) === -1) tags.push(apps[i]);
    return "AIDRPG PRIORITY ABILITY: Ember Ward is a recent defensive fire ward for protection, allies/team cover, and low ember dome use" + (tags.length ? " (" + tags.join(", ") + ")" : "") + ".";
  }

  function applyPublicReputation(root, rawText) {
    const raw = textOf(rawText);
    const s = lower(raw);
    if (!/\b(?:word spreads|news spreads|rumors? spread|town praises|village praises|people praise|known as|praised as|called a hero|save[sd]? the|rescued? the)\b/.test(s)) return 0;
    if (!/\b(?:hero|praises?|saved?|rescued?|market|town|village|bandits?|deed|word spreads|known as)\b/.test(s)) return 0;
    const R = A.ReputationSystem;
    if (R && typeof R.applyReputationShift === "function") {
      const subject = R.resolveSubject && typeof R.resolveSubject === "function" ? R.resolveSubject("local_group", root) : { id: "local_group", displayName: "local community", scope: "local" };
      const changed = R.applyReputationShift(subject, "positive", raw, root);
      if (changed > 0) return changed;
    }
    if (!root.reputation || typeof root.reputation !== "object") root.reputation = {};
    if (!root.reputation.bySubject || typeof root.reputation.bySubject !== "object") root.reputation.bySubject = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(root.reputation.recentChanges)) root.reputation.recentChanges = [];
    const id = "local_group";
    if (!root.reputation.bySubject[id]) {
      root.reputation.bySubject[id] = { identity: { id, displayName: "local community", scope: "local" }, mutable: { score: 0, standing: "neutral", tags: [], notes: [], lastChangedTurn: 0 } };
    }
    const rec = root.reputation.bySubject[id];
    rec.mutable.score = Math.min(100, Number(rec.mutable.score || 0) + 10);
    rec.mutable.standing = rec.mutable.score >= 20 ? "liked" : "positive";
    if (rec.mutable.tags.indexOf("public_praise") === -1) rec.mutable.tags.push("public_praise");
    rec.mutable.lastChangedTurn = root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0;
    root.reputation.recentChanges.push({ turn: rec.mutable.lastChangedTurn, subject: rec.identity.displayName, subjectId: id, direction: "positive", delta: 10, evidence: raw.slice(0, 180) });
    while (root.reputation.recentChanges.length > 16) root.reputation.recentChanges.shift();
    markDirty(root, "reputation", true);
    return 1;
  }

  function postOutputStabilize(root, rawText) {
    let changes = 0;
    changes += compactOwnedItems(root);
    changes += detectConsumedHealingVial(root, rawText);
    changes += detectRouteDelay(root, rawText);
    changes += ensureEmberWard(root, rawText);
    changes += applyPublicReputation(root, rawText);
    const after = compactOwnedItems(root);
    changes += after;
    if (changes > 0) {
      if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") {
        try { A.Utils.invalidatePackets(root); } catch (_error) {}
      }
      pushLog(root, "v1.2.7 final stabilizer changes: " + changes);
    }
    return changes;
  }

  // Add route delay details to /time without replacing the original display.
  if (A.AdminDebugSystem && !A.AdminDebugSystem.__aidrpg127TimeFormat) {
    const oldFormatTime = A.AdminDebugSystem.formatTime;
    A.AdminDebugSystem.formatTime = function aidrpg127FormatTime() {
      let out = oldFormatTime ? oldFormatTime.call(this) : "[AIDRPG /time]\n";
      const root = ensureRoot();
      const routes = root.time && root.time.routes && root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes ? root.time.routes.knownTravelTimes : {};
      const details = [];
      const seen = Object.create(null);
      const keys = Object.keys(routes).slice(0, 30);
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length && details.length < 5; i += 1) {
        const rec = routes[keys[i]];
        if (!rec || !rec.fromRef || !rec.toRef) continue;
        const canon = [toKey(rec.fromRef), toKey(rec.toRef)].sort().join("__");
        if (seen[canon]) continue;
        seen[canon] = true;
        if (rec.lastActualMinutes && rec.minutes && rec.lastActualMinutes !== rec.minutes) {
          const reason = rec.lastDelayReason ? " due to " + rec.lastDelayReason : "";
          details.push(cleanSpaces(rec.fromRef) + " <-> " + cleanSpaces(rec.toRef) + " last actual " + rec.lastActualMinutes + "m vs base " + rec.minutes + "m" + reason);
        }
      }
      if (details.length) out += "\nRoute Delay Details: " + details.join("; ") + "\n";
      return out;
    };
    A.AdminDebugSystem.__aidrpg127TimeFormat = true;
  }

  // Keep Ember Ward visible by prepending its priority line before lower-priority context filler can crowd it out.
  const oldOnContext = A.onContext;
  A.onContext = function aidrpg127OnContext(textValue) {
    const result = oldOnContext.call(this, textValue);
    const root = ensureRoot();
    const line = emberPriorityLine(root);
    if (!line || !result || typeof result.text !== "string") return result;
    if (result.text.indexOf("AIDRPG PRIORITY ABILITY: Ember Ward") !== -1) return result;
    const max = (typeof info === "object" && Number(info.maxChars)) ? Math.max(1200, Number(info.maxChars) - 40) : 9000;
    const bodyBudget = Math.max(200, max - line.length - 2);
    const body = result.text.length > bodyBudget ? result.text.slice(0, bodyBudget).trimEnd() : result.text;
    result.text = line + "\n" + body;
    return result;
  };

  const oldOnOutput = A.onOutput;
  A.onOutput = function aidrpg127OnOutput(textValue) {
    const raw = textOf(textValue);
    let result;
    try {
      result = oldOnOutput.call(this, textValue);
    } finally {
      const root = ensureRoot();
      try { postOutputStabilize(root, raw); }
      catch (error) { pushLog(root, "v1.2.7 final stabilizer fail-soft: " + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error))); }
    }
    return result || { text: raw };
  };

  A.VERSION = FINAL_VERSION;
  A.BUILD_STAGE = FINAL_STAGE;
  A.__aidrpg127FinalRelease = true;
})();

  function textOf(value) {
    try { return typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value ?? ""); }
    catch (_error) { return ""; }
  }
  function cleanSpaces(value) { return textOf(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); }
  function toKey(value) {
    return cleanSpaces(value)
      .normalize("NFKD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[’'`´"]/g, "")
      .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2")
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_")
      .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "")
      .replace(/_+/g, "_");
  }
  function ensureRoot() {
    if (!state.aidrpg || typeof state.aidrpg !== "object" || Array.isArray(state.aidrpg)) {
      if (A.CoreState && typeof A.CoreState.init === "function") return A.CoreState.init();
      state.aidrpg = {};
    }
    return state.aidrpg;
  }
  function markAbilityDirty(root, id) {
    try {

    } catch (_error) {}
  }
  function pushLog(root, message) {

      if (!Array.isArray(root.logs.recentParses)) root.logs.recentParses = [];
