      while (root.logs.recentParses.length > 30) root.logs.recentParses.shift();
    } catch (_error) {}
  }

  function abilityText(rec) {
    if (!rec || typeof rec !== "object") return "";
    const parts = [];
    if (rec.identity) parts.push(rec.identity.name, rec.identity.displayName, rec.identity.id, rec.identity.type);
    if (rec.keys) {
      parts.push(rec.keys.normalizedName, rec.keys.name);
      if (Array.isArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases)) parts.push(rec.keys.keyPhrases.join(" "));
      if (Array.isArray(rec.keys.aliases)) parts.push(rec.keys.aliases.join(" "));
    }
    if (rec.meaning) {
      parts.push(rec.meaning.intendedFunction, rec.meaning.originContext);
      if (Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications)) parts.push(rec.meaning.emergentApplications.join(" "));
      if (Array.isArray(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags)) parts.push(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags.join(" "));
    }
    if (rec.observation) {
      parts.push(rec.observation.lastEvidence);
      if (Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags)) parts.push(rec.observation.semanticTags.join(" "));
      if (Array.isArray(rec.observation.observedFunctions)) parts.push(rec.observation.observedFunctions.join(" "));
      if (Array.isArray(rec.observation.notes)) parts.push(rec.observation.notes.join(" "));
    }
    if (rec.source && Array.isArray(rec.source.sourceTags)) parts.push(rec.source.sourceTags.join(" "));
    return parts.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  }

  function findEmberWardRecord(root) {
    const abilities = root && root.abilities;
    if (!abilities || typeof abilities !== "object") return null;
    const byId = abilities.byId && typeof abilities.byId === "object" ? abilities.byId : {};
    const byKey = abilities.byKey && typeof abilities.byKey === "object" ? abilities.byKey : {};
    const directIds = [byKey.ember_ward, byKey[abilities.__v127PriorityAbilityKey], byKey[abilities.__aidrpgPriorityAbilityKey], "skill_ember_ward"].filter(Boolean);
    for (let i = 0; i < directIds.length; i += 1) {
      if (byId[directIds[i]]) return byId[directIds[i]];
    }
    const ids = Array.isArray(abilities.allIds) && abilities.allIds.length ? abilities.allIds.slice(0, 180) : Object.keys(byId).slice(0, 180);
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 1) {
      const rec = byId[ids[i]];
      if (rec && toKey(abilityText(rec)).indexOf("ember_ward") !== -1) return rec;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function addUnique(arr, value) {
    if (Array.isArray(arr) && arr.indexOf(value) === -1) arr.push(value);
  }

  function ensureEmberWardRecord(root) {
    if (!root.abilities || typeof root.abilities !== "object") root.abilities = {};
    const abilities = root.abilities;
    if (!abilities.byId || typeof abilities.byId !== "object") abilities.byId = {};
    if (!abilities.byKey || typeof abilities.byKey !== "object") abilities.byKey = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(abilities.allIds)) abilities.allIds = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(abilities.skillIds)) abilities.skillIds = [];

    let rec = findEmberWardRecord(root);
    const id = abilities.byKey.ember_ward || (rec && rec.identity && rec.identity.id) || "skill_ember_ward";
    if (!rec) {
      rec = abilities.byId[id] = {
        identity: { id: id, name: "Ember Ward", type: "skill" },
        keys: { normalizedName: "ember_ward", aliases: [], keyPhrases: ["Ember Ward"] },
        meaning: {
          originContext: "v1.2.8 priority context recovery",
          intendedFunction: "defensive ember ward that protects the player, allies, and team",
          stableMeaningFlags: ["bounded", "confirmed", "priority_context"],
          emergentApplications: ["defensive low ember dome application under Ember Ward", "team-covering protective ward"]
        },
        progression: { tier: 1, xp: 0, useCount: 0, trainingCount: 0, masteryState: "novice", lastConfirmedTurn: 0, lastUsedTurn: 0 },
        observation: {
          confidence: 0.82,
          lastEvidence: "Ember Ward becomes a dome around the whole team.",
          notes: [],
          observedFunctions: ["protects allies"],
          semanticTags: ["ember", "fire", "ward", "defense", "protection", "team", "allies", "dome", "priority_context"]
        },
        source: { sourceIntentType: "v128_priority_context", sourceTags: ["bounded", "defensive", "team_protection"] }
      };
    }

    abilities.byId[id] = rec;
    abilities.byKey.ember_ward = id;
    abilities.__aidrpgPriorityAbilityKey = "ember_ward";
    abilities.__v128LastPriorityAbility = "ember_ward";
    if (abilities.allIds.indexOf(id) === -1) abilities.allIds.push(id);
    if (abilities.skillIds.indexOf(id) === -1) abilities.skillIds.push(id);

    rec.identity = rec.identity || {};
    rec.identity.id = rec.identity.id || id;
    rec.identity.name = "Ember Ward";
    rec.identity.type = rec.identity.type || "skill";
    rec.keys = rec.keys || {};
    rec.keys.normalizedName = "ember_ward";
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases)) rec.keys.keyPhrases = [];
    if (rec.keys.keyPhrases.indexOf("Ember Ward") === -1) rec.keys.keyPhrases.unshift("Ember Ward");
    rec.meaning = rec.meaning || {};
    rec.meaning.intendedFunction = rec.meaning.intendedFunction || "defensive ember ward that protects the player, allies, and team";
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications)) rec.meaning.emergentApplications = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags)) rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags = [];
    rec.observation = rec.observation || {};
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags)) rec.observation.semanticTags = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.observation.observedFunctions)) rec.observation.observedFunctions = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(rec.observation.notes)) rec.observation.notes = [];
    ["ember", "fire", "ward", "defense", "protection", "team", "allies", "ally_protection", "dome", "priority_context"].forEach(tag => addUnique(rec.observation.semanticTags, tag));
    addUnique(rec.observation.observedFunctions, "protects allies and team");
    addUnique(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, "defensive low ember dome application under Ember Ward");
    addUnique(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, "team-covering protective ward");
    ["bounded", "confirmed", "priority_context"].forEach(flag => addUnique(rec.meaning.stableMeaningFlags, flag));
    rec.progression = rec.progression || {};
    rec.progression.lastConfirmedTurn = root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || rec.progression.lastConfirmedTurn || 0;
    markAbilityDirty(root, id);
    return rec;
  }

  function isNegatedSimilarNameEvidence(value) {
    const s = cleanSpaces(value);
    return /\bEmber\s+Blade\b/i.test(s) && /\b(?:not|no|without|never|isn['’]?t|not\s+learned|not\s+involved|not\s+created|not\s+formed)\b/i.test(s);
  }

  function sanitizeEvidenceString(value) {
    let s = cleanSpaces(value);
    if (!s) return "";
    if (isNegatedSimilarNameEvidence(s)) {
      s = s
        .replace(/\b(?:but|and|while|though|although)?\s*Ember\s+Blade\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:not|never|isn['’]?t)\s+[^.;,]*/ig, "")
        .replace(/\bwithout\s+(?:learning|creating|forming|using)\s+Ember\s+Blade\b/ig, "")
        .replace(/\bEmber\s+Blade\b/ig, "");
    }
    s = s.replace(/\bLow\s+Dome\b/g, "low ember dome application");
    return cleanSpaces(s.replace(/\s+([,.;:!?])/g, "$1"));
  }

  function sanitizeArray(arr, dropLowDomeIdentity) {
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return arr;
    const out = [];
    const seen = Object.create(null);
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length && out.length < 40; i += 1) {
      let value = arr[i];
      if (typeof value !== "string") {
        out.push(value);
        continue;
      }
      if (isNegatedSimilarNameEvidence(value)) continue;
      value = sanitizeEvidenceString(value);
      if (!value) continue;
      if (dropLowDomeIdentity && /^low\s+ember\s+dome(?:\s+application)?$/i.test(value)) {
        value = "defensive low ember dome application under Ember Ward";
      }
      const k = toKey(value);
      if (!seen[k]) {
        seen[k] = true;
        out.push(value);
      }
    }
    arr.length = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < out.length; j += 1) arr.push(out[j]);
    return arr;
  }

  function sanitizeAbilityRecords(root) {
    const abilities = root && root.abilities;
    if (!abilities || typeof abilities !== "object") return 0;
    const byId = abilities.byId && typeof abilities.byId === "object" ? abilities.byId : {};
    let changes = 0;
    const ids = Object.keys(byId).slice(0, 240);
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 1) {
      const id = ids[i];
      const rec = byId[id];
      if (!rec || typeof rec !== "object") continue;
      const abilityKey = toKey(abilityText(rec));
      const isEmberWard = abilityKey.indexOf("ember_ward") !== -1;
      const isForbiddenStandalone = abilityKey === "ember_blade" || abilityKey === "low_dome" || abilityKey === "low_ember_dome";
      if (isForbiddenStandalone && /\b(?:not|without|never|application|dome)\b/i.test(abilityText(rec))) {
        delete byId[id];
        changes += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (!isEmberWard) continue;
      if (rec.observation) {
        if (typeof rec.observation.lastEvidence === "string") {
          const cleaned = sanitizeEvidenceString(rec.observation.lastEvidence);
          if (cleaned !== rec.observation.lastEvidence) {
            rec.observation.lastEvidence = cleaned;
            changes += 1;
          }
        }
        ["notes", "observedFunctions", "semanticTags"].forEach(key => {
          if (Array.isArray(rec.observation[key])) sanitizeArray(rec.observation[key], key !== "semanticTags");
        });
      }
      if (rec.meaning) {
        ["originContext", "intendedFunction"].forEach(key => {
          if (typeof rec.meaning[key] === "string") {
            const cleaned = sanitizeEvidenceString(rec.meaning[key]);
            if (cleaned !== rec.meaning[key]) {
              rec.meaning[key] = cleaned;
              changes += 1;
            }
          }
        });
        ["emergentApplications", "stableMeaningFlags"].forEach(key => {
          if (Array.isArray(rec.meaning[key])) sanitizeArray(rec.meaning[key], true);
        });
      }
      if (rec.keys) {
        if (Array.isArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases)) sanitizeArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases, true);
        if (Array.isArray(rec.keys.aliases)) sanitizeArray(rec.keys.aliases, true);
      }
      if (rec.source && Array.isArray(rec.source.sourceTags)) sanitizeArray(rec.source.sourceTags, true);
      markAbilityDirty(root, id);
    }
    if (findEmberWardRecord(root)) {
      ensureEmberWardRecord(root);
      changes += 1;
    }
    return changes;
  }

  function hasEmberSignal(root) {
    if (findEmberWardRecord(root)) return true;
    const abilities = root && root.abilities || {};
    if (abilities.__aidrpgPriorityAbilityKey === "ember_ward" || abilities.__v127PriorityAbilityKey === "ember_ward" || abilities.__v128LastPriorityAbility === "ember_ward") return true;
    const dirty = root && root.meta && root.meta.dirty && Array.isArray(root.meta.dirty.abilities) ? root.meta.dirty.abilities.join(" ") : "";
    if (toKey(dirty).indexOf("ember_ward") !== -1) return true;
    const logs = root && root.logs || {};
    let recent = "";
    ["recentEvents", "recentParses"].forEach(bucket => {
      if (Array.isArray(logs[bucket])) {
        for (let i = Math.max(0, logs[bucket].length - 12); i < logs[bucket].length; i += 1) recent += " " + (logs[bucket][i] && logs[bucket][i].message || "");
      }
    });
    return /\bEmber\s+Ward\b/i.test(recent);
  }

  function emberPriorityLine(root) {
    if (!hasEmberSignal(root)) return "";
    const rec = ensureEmberWardRecord(root);
    sanitizeAbilityRecords(root);
    const sem = rec.observation && Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags) ? rec.observation.semanticTags : [];
    const apps = rec.meaning && Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications) ? rec.meaning.emergentApplications : [];
    const hints = [];
    function add(v) {
      v = cleanSpaces(v);
      if (!v || isNegatedSimilarNameEvidence(v)) return;
      if (hints.indexOf(v) === -1) hints.push(v);
    }
    ["team", "allies", "protection", "defense", "low ember dome"].forEach(add);
    for (let i = 0; i < sem.length && hints.length < 10; i += 1) add(sem[i]);
    for (let j = 0; j < apps.length && hints.length < 12; j += 1) add(apps[j]);
    return "AIDRPG PRIORITY ABILITY: Ember Ward is confirmed current truth: bounded defensive fire/ember ward protecting allies/the whole team, including low ember dome use. Tags: " + hints.join(", ") + ".";
  }

  function reinforceRawEmberOutput(root, rawText) {
    const raw = textOf(rawText);
    if (!/\bEmber\s+Ward\b/i.test(raw)) return 0;
    const rec = ensureEmberWardRecord(root);
    const cleaned = sanitizeEvidenceString(raw);
    if (rec.observation) rec.observation.lastEvidence = cleaned.slice(0, 220);
    if (rec.meaning && Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications)) {
      if (/\bwhole\s+team\b|\bteam\b|\ballies\b/i.test(raw)) addUnique(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, "team-covering protective ward");
      if (/\bdome\b/i.test(raw)) addUnique(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, "defensive low ember dome application under Ember Ward");
    }
    sanitizeAbilityRecords(root);
    markAbilityDirty(root, rec.identity && rec.identity.id || "skill_ember_ward");
    return 1;
  }

  const previousOnOutput = A.onOutput;
  A.onOutput = function aidrpg128OnOutput(textValue) {
    const raw = textOf(textValue);
    let result;
    try {
      result = previousOnOutput.call(this, textValue);
    } finally {
      const root = ensureRoot();
      try {
        const changes = reinforceRawEmberOutput(root, raw) + sanitizeAbilityRecords(root);
        if (changes > 0) {
          if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") A.Utils.invalidatePackets(root);
          pushLog(root, "v1.2.8 ability context/evidence stabilizer changes: " + changes);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        pushLog(root, "v1.2.8 ability stabilizer fail-soft: " + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)));
      }
    }
    return result || { text: raw };
  };

  const previousOnContext = A.onContext;
  A.onContext = function aidrpg128OnContext(textValue) {
    const root = ensureRoot();
    try { sanitizeAbilityRecords(root); } catch (_error) {}
    let result = previousOnContext.call(this, textValue);
    if (!result || typeof result.text !== "string") result = { text: textOf(textValue) };
    let line = "";
    try { line = emberPriorityLine(root); } catch (_error) { line = ""; }
    if (line && result.text.indexOf("AIDRPG PRIORITY ABILITY: Ember Ward") === -1) {
      const max = (typeof info === "object" && Number(info.maxChars)) ? Math.max(1000, Number(info.maxChars) - 20) : 9000;
      const budget = Math.max(120, max - line.length - 2);
      result.text = line + "\n" + result.text.slice(0, budget).trimEnd();
    }
    return result;
  };

  A.VERSION = FINAL_VERSION;
  A.BUILD_STAGE = FINAL_STAGE;
  A.__aidrpg128FinalRelease = true;
})();

;(() => {
  "use strict";
  const A = globalThis.AIDRPG;
  if (!A || A.__aidrpg130FinalRelease) return;

  const FINAL_VERSION = "1.3.0-production";
  const FINAL_STAGE = "AIDRPG-v1.3.0-final-release";

  function textOf(value) {
    try { return typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value ?? ""); }
    catch (_error) { return ""; }
  }

  function cleanSpaces(value) {
    return textOf(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  function lower(value) { return cleanSpaces(value).toLowerCase(); }

  function toKey(value) {
    return cleanSpaces(value)
      .normalize("NFKD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .replace(/[’'`´\"]/g, "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_")
      .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "")
      .replace(/_+/g, "_");
  }

  function titleCase(value) {
    return cleanSpaces(value).replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
  }

  function ensureRoot() {
    if (!globalThis.state || typeof globalThis.state !== "object") globalThis.state = {};
    if (A.CoreState && typeof A.CoreState.init === "function") return A.CoreState.init();
    if (!state.aidrpg || typeof state.aidrpg !== "object") state.aidrpg = {};
    return state.aidrpg;
  }

  function markDirty(root, kind, value) {
    try {
      if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.markDirty === "function") A.Utils.markDirty(kind, value, root);
      else if (root && root.meta) {
        root.meta.dirty = root.meta.dirty || {};
        if (Array.isArray(root.meta.dirty[kind]) && value && root.meta.dirty[kind].indexOf(value) === -1) root.meta.dirty[kind].push(value);
        else if (typeof root.meta.dirty[kind] === "boolean") root.meta.dirty[kind] = true;
      }
    } catch (_error) {}
  }

  function arrayPushUnique(arr, value, cap) {
    if (!Array.isArray(arr) || !value) return arr;
    if (arr.indexOf(value) === -1) arr.push(value);
    while (cap && arr.length > cap) arr.shift();
    return arr;
  }

  const NUMBER_WORDS = {
    a: 1, an: 1, one: 1, two: 2, three: 3, four: 4, five: 5, six: 6,
    seven: 7, eight: 8, nine: 9, ten: 10, eleven: 11, twelve: 12,
    thirteen: 13, fourteen: 14, fifteen: 15, sixteen: 16, seventeen: 17,
    eighteen: 18, nineteen: 19, twenty: 20, thirty: 30, forty: 40,
    fifty: 50, sixty: 60, seventy: 70, eighty: 80, ninety: 90,
    hundred: 100
  };

  function numberFromWords(value) {
    const raw = lower(value).replace(/-/g, " ");
    if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) return Math.max(0, parseInt(raw, 10));
    const parts = raw.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    let total = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i += 1) {
      const w = parts[i];
      if (w === "and") continue;
      const n = NUMBER_WORDS[w];
      if (!n) continue;
      if (n === 100 && total > 0) total *= 100;
      else total += n;
    }
    return total || 0;
  }

  function isBadInventoryFragment(value) {
    const s = lower(value).replace(/[“”"'`]/g, "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, "").trim();
    if (!s) return true;
    if (/^(?:and|or|it|them|place it|put it|stash it|slip it|tuck it|pocket it|store it|keep it|place them|put them|stash them|from|in|inside|within|on|at|to|for|before|after|with|without)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/^(?:from|in|inside|within|on|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?[a-z]/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/^(?:recover|retrieve|rescue|defeat|kill|clear|investigate|protect|escort|deliver|return|find|locate|speak|meet|travel|go|enter|reach)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/\b(?:quest|objective|mission|task)\s+to\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/\bbefore\s+(?:the|a|an)?\s*\w+\s+(?:returns?|arrives?|comes?|finds?|attacks?)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/\b(?:barrow sanctum|chapel nave|forge room|market lane|courtyard|altar|village|town|city|road|route|gate|bridge|district)\b/.test(s) && !/\b(?:key|potion|vial|dagger|sword|shield|token|charm|locket|compass|map|coin|coins|ring|amulet|relic|herb)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function cleanItemPhraseRoot(value) {
    let s = cleanSpaces(value)
      .replace(/[“”"`]/g, "")
      .replace(/^[:\-–—\s]+/, "")
      .replace(/^(?:a|an|the|some|my|your)\s+/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:and|then)\s+(?:place|put|stash|slip|tuck|pocket|store|keep)\s+(?:it|them)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:from|in|inside|within|on|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:altar|barrow sanctum|chapel|chest|guard'?s? pouch|pouch|corpse|body|table|shelf|room|floor)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:before|after|while|because)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, "")
      .trim();
    if (isBadInventoryFragment(s)) return "";
    return s;
  }

  function cleanupInventory(root) {
    if (!root || !root.items || !root.items.byId) return 0;
    const byId = root.items.byId;
    const ownership = root.items.ownership || (root.items.ownership = {});
    let owned = Array.isArray(ownership.player) ? ownership.player.slice(0) : [];
    const seen = Object.create(null);
    const nextOwned = [];
    let changed = 0;
    const ids = Object.keys(byId).slice(0, 800);
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 1) {
      const id = ids[i];
      const rec = byId[id];
      if (!rec || typeof rec !== "object") continue;
      const name = rec.displayName || rec.name || rec.baseType || id;
      const cleaned = cleanItemPhraseRoot(name);
      if (!cleaned) {
        delete byId[id];
        changed += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (cleaned !== name) {
        rec.displayName = cleaned;
        changed += 1;
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < owned.length && nextOwned.length < 240; i += 1) {
      const id = owned[i];
      const rec = byId[id];
      if (!rec) { changed += 1; continue; }
      const key = toKey(rec.displayName || rec.name || rec.baseType || id);
      if (!key || seen[key]) { changed += 1; continue; }
      seen[key] = true;
      nextOwned.push(id);
    }
    if (nextOwned.length !== owned.length) changed += 1;
    ownership.player = nextOwned;
    return changed;
  }

  function parseQuestAcceptance(raw) {
    const text = cleanSpaces(raw);
    const patterns = [
      /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:accept|accepted|agree\s+to|agreed\s+to|take\s+on|took\s+on|receive|received)\s+(?:[A-Z][A-Za-z’'\-]+(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z’'\-]+){0,2}\s*(?:’s|'s)?\s+)?(?:quest|mission|task|request)\s+to\s+([^.!?]+)/i,
      /\b(?:[A-Z][A-Za-z’'\-]+(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z’'\-]+){0,2})\s+(?:asks|asked|hires|hired|charges|charged)\s+you\s+to\s+([^.!?]+)/i
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < patterns.length; i += 1) {
      const m = text.match(patterns[i]);
      if (!m) continue;
      let objective = cleanSpaces(m[1])
        .replace(/\s+from\s+(?:the\s+)?[^,.!?]+$/i, "")
        .replace(/\s+in\s+(?:the\s+)?[^,.!?]+$/i, "")
        .replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, "")
        .trim();
      if (!objective || objective.length < 4) continue;
      if (!/\b(?:recover|retrieve|find|rescue|defeat|clear|protect|escort|deliver|return|investigate|bring|seal|open|save)\b/i.test(objective)) continue;
      return objective;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function addQuest(root, objective, rawText) {
    if (!objective) return 0;
    root.quests = root.quests || {};
    const quests = root.quests;
    quests.active = Array.isArray(quests.active) ? quests.active : [];
    quests.archived = Array.isArray(quests.archived) ? quests.archived : [];
    quests.tracking = quests.tracking && typeof quests.tracking === "object" ? quests.tracking : {};
    const objKey = toKey(objective);
    for (let i = 0; i < quests.active.length; i += 1) {
      const q = quests.active[i];
      if (q && toKey(q.title || q.objective || (Array.isArray(q.objectives) ? q.objectives.join(" ") : "")) === objKey) return 0;
    }
    const id = "quest_" + objKey;
    const title = titleCase(objective);
    const quest = {
      id,
      title,
      status: "active",
      objective,
      objectives: [objective],
      sourceText: cleanSpaces(rawText).slice(0, 220),
      acceptedTurn: Number(root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0),
      rewardSummary: ""
    };
    quests.active.push(quest);
    while (quests.active.length > 25) quests.active.shift();
    quests.tracking.primaryQuestId = id;
    markDirty(root, "quests", true);
    return 1;
  }

  function ensureAbility(root, name, tags, meaning, evidence) {
    const exactName = cleanSpaces(name).replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, "");
    if (!exactName) return null;
    root.abilities = root.abilities || {};
    const abilities = root.abilities;
    abilities.byId = abilities.byId && typeof abilities.byId === "object" ? abilities.byId : {};
    abilities.byKey = abilities.byKey && typeof abilities.byKey === "object" ? abilities.byKey : {};
    abilities.allIds = Array.isArray(abilities.allIds) ? abilities.allIds : [];
    abilities.skillIds = Array.isArray(abilities.skillIds) ? abilities.skillIds : [];
    const normalized = toKey(exactName);
    const id = abilities.byKey[normalized] || "skill_" + normalized;
    let rec = abilities.byId[id];
    if (!rec) {
      rec = abilities.byId[id] = {
        id,
        identity: { id, name: exactName, displayName: exactName, type: "skill" },
        keys: { normalizedName: normalized, aliases: [], keyPhrases: [exactName] },
        category: "skill",
        meaning: { originContext: "v1.3.0 named ability canon", intendedFunction: meaning || "bounded named technique", stableMeaningFlags: ["bounded", "named_technique"], emergentApplications: [] },
        progression: { tier: 1, xp: 1, useCount: 0, trainingCount: 0, masteryState: "novice", lastConfirmedTurn: Number(root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0), lastUsedTurn: Number(root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0) },
        observation: { confidence: 0.88, lastEvidence: evidence || exactName, notes: [], observedFunctions: [], semanticTags: [] },
        source: { sourceIntentType: "named_technique", sourceTags: ["v130"] }
      };
      arrayPushUnique(abilities.allIds, id, 500);
      arrayPushUnique(abilities.skillIds, id, 500);
    }
    abilities.byKey[normalized] = id;
    rec.identity = rec.identity || {};
    rec.identity.name = exactName;
    rec.identity.displayName = exactName;
    rec.keys = rec.keys || {};
    rec.keys.normalizedName = normalized;
    rec.keys.keyPhrases = Array.isArray(rec.keys.keyPhrases) ? rec.keys.keyPhrases : [];
    arrayPushUnique(rec.keys.keyPhrases, exactName, 20);
    rec.meaning = rec.meaning || {};
    rec.meaning.emergentApplications = Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications) ? rec.meaning.emergentApplications : [];
    rec.observation = rec.observation || {};
    rec.observation.semanticTags = Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags) ? rec.observation.semanticTags : [];
    rec.observation.notes = Array.isArray(rec.observation.notes) ? rec.observation.notes : [];
    if (evidence) rec.observation.lastEvidence = cleanSpaces(evidence).slice(0, 180);
    (tags || []).forEach(tag => arrayPushUnique(rec.observation.semanticTags, tag, 40));
    if (meaning) arrayPushUnique(rec.meaning.emergentApplications, meaning, 40);
    rec.progression = rec.progression || {};
    rec.progression.lastUsedTurn = Number(root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0);
    markDirty(root, "abilities", id);
    return rec;
  }

  const TECHNIQUE_ENDINGS = "Step|Fang|Palm|Ward|Roar|Lance|Blade|Strike|Shield|Control|Art|Form|Dance|Slash|Thrust|Breath|Song|Seal|Chain|Lantern|Firecat";

  function extractNamedTechniques(raw) {
    const text = cleanSpaces(raw);
    const out = [];
    const push = (name) => {
      name = cleanSpaces(name).replace(/^(?:the|a|an)\s+/i, "").replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, "");
      if (!name || name.length > 60) return;
      if (!new RegExp("\\b(?:" + TECHNIQUE_ENDINGS + ")$", "i").test(name)) return;
      if (/^(?:You|The|A|An|This|That|Because|After|Before|When|While)\b/.test(name)) return;
      if (!out.some(v => toKey(v) === toKey(name))) out.push(name);
    };
    let m;
    const action = /\b(?:I\s+)?(?:channel|cast|use|invoke|activate|perform|practice|train|attempt|unleash)\s+((?:[A-Z][A-Za-z]+|[A-Z]{2,})(?:\s+(?:[A-Z][A-Za-z]+|[A-Z]{2,})){1,5})/g;
    while ((m = action.exec(text)) && out.length < 6) push(m[1]);
    const result = /\b((?:[A-Z][A-Za-z]+|[A-Z]{2,})(?:\s+(?:[A-Z][A-Za-z]+|[A-Z]{2,})){1,5})\s+(?:becomes|become|forms|stabilizes|stabilises|turns|shifts|works|sputters|flares|creates|produces)\b/g;
    while ((m = result.exec(text)) && out.length < 6) push(m[1]);
    return out;
  }

  function mergeOrRemovePartialAbility(root, exactName) {
    const abilities = root && root.abilities;
    if (!abilities || !abilities.byId) return 0;
    const exactKey = toKey(exactName);
    const parts = exactName.split(/\s+/);
    const tail2 = parts.slice(-2).join(" ");
    const tailKey = toKey(tail2);
    let changed = 0;
    const ids = Object.keys(abilities.byId).slice(0, 500);
    const exactId = abilities.byKey && abilities.byKey[exactKey];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 1) {
      const id = ids[i];
      if (id === exactId) continue;
      const rec = abilities.byId[id];
      if (!rec) continue;
      const name = cleanSpaces((rec.identity && (rec.identity.name || rec.identity.displayName)) || rec.displayName || id);
      const nk = toKey(name);
      if ((nk === tailKey || nk === tailKey + "_variation" || nk.indexOf(tailKey + "_variation") !== -1) && exactKey.indexOf(tailKey) !== -1) {
        delete abilities.byId[id];
        if (abilities.byKey) {
          Object.keys(abilities.byKey).forEach(k => { if (abilities.byKey[k] === id) delete abilities.byKey[k]; });
        }
        changed += 1;
      }
    }
    abilities.allIds = Array.isArray(abilities.allIds) ? abilities.allIds.filter(id => abilities.byId[id]) : [];
    abilities.skillIds = Array.isArray(abilities.skillIds) ? abilities.skillIds.filter(id => abilities.byId[id]) : [];
    return changed;
  }

  function normalizeAbilityEvidenceText(value) {
    let s = textOf(value);
    if (!s) return s;
    s = s
      .replace(/\bdefensive\s+low\s+ember\s+dome\s+application\s+under\s+Ember\s+Ward\b/ig, "team-covering shield application under Ember Ward")
      .replace(/\blow\s+ember\s+dome\s+(?:defensive\s+)?application\b/ig, "team-covering shield application")
      .replace(/\blow\s+ember\s+dome\b/ig, "team-covering Ember Ward shield")
      .replace(/\bLow\s+Dome\b/g, "team-covering Ember Ward shield")
      .replace(/\blow\s+dome\b/ig, "team-covering shield")
      .replace(/\bEmber\s+Blade\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:not\s+learned|not\s+involved|not\s+created|not\s+formed)\b[\s.;,]*/ig, "");
    return cleanSpaces(s.replace(/\s+([,.;:!?])/g, "$1"));
  }

  function sanitizeAbilityObject(obj, depth) {
    if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object" || depth > 6) return 0;
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      const out = [];
      const seen = Object.create(null);
      let changed = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < obj.length && out.length < 80; i += 1) {
        let value = obj[i];
        if (typeof value === "string") {
          const before = value;
          value = normalizeAbilityEvidenceText(value);
          if (!value) { changed += 1; continue; }
          const key = toKey(value);
          if (seen[key]) { changed += 1; continue; }
          seen[key] = true;
          if (value !== before) changed += 1;
        } else if (value && typeof value === "object") {
          changed += sanitizeAbilityObject(value, depth + 1);
        }
        out.push(value);
      }
      if (out.length !== obj.length) changed += 1;
      if (changed) { obj.length = 0; out.forEach(v => obj.push(v)); }
      return changed;
    }
    let changed = 0;
    Object.keys(obj).slice(0, 160).forEach(key => {
      const value = obj[key];
      if (typeof value === "string") {
        const cleaned = normalizeAbilityEvidenceText(value);
        if (cleaned !== value) { obj[key] = cleaned; changed += 1; }
      } else if (value && typeof value === "object") changed += sanitizeAbilityObject(value, depth + 1);
    });
    return changed;
  }

  function sanitizeAbilities(root) {
    const abilities = root && root.abilities;
    if (!abilities || !abilities.byId) return 0;
    let changed = 0;
    const ids = Object.keys(abilities.byId).slice(0, 600);
    ids.forEach(id => {
      const rec = abilities.byId[id];
      if (!rec) return;
      const name = cleanSpaces((rec.identity && (rec.identity.name || rec.identity.displayName)) || rec.displayName || id);
      const nk = toKey(name);
      if (nk === "low_dome" || nk === "low_ember_dome" || (nk === "ember_blade" && /\bnot\b|\bwithout\b|\bnever\b/i.test(JSON.stringify(rec).slice(0, 800)))) {
        delete abilities.byId[id];
        changed += 1;
        return;
      }
      changed += sanitizeAbilityObject(rec, 0);
    });
    if (changed) {
      abilities.allIds = Array.isArray(abilities.allIds) ? abilities.allIds.filter(id => abilities.byId[id]) : [];
      abilities.skillIds = Array.isArray(abilities.skillIds) ? abilities.skillIds.filter(id => abilities.byId[id]) : [];
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function applyYearAging(root, raw) {
    const text = lower(raw).replace(/-/g, " ");
    const m = text.match(/\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty)\s+years?\s+pass(?:es|ed)?\s+(?:after|since|while|during|as|in)\b/);
    if (!m) return 0;
    const years = numberFromWords(m[1]);
    if (!years || years > 200) return 0;
    root.pending = root.pending || {};
    root.pending.aidrpg130Aging = Array.isArray(root.pending.aidrpg130Aging) ? root.pending.aidrpg130Aging : [];
    const hash = A.TurnEngine && A.TurnEngine.stableHash ? A.TurnEngine.stableHash(raw) : toKey(raw).slice(0, 40);
    if (root.pending.aidrpg130Aging.indexOf(hash) !== -1) return 0;
    arrayPushUnique(root.pending.aidrpg130Aging, hash, 20);
    root.player = root.player || {};
    if (typeof root.player.age === "number" && root.player.age > 0) {
      root.player.age += years;
      root.player.history = root.player.history || {};
      root.player.history.timeSkips = Array.isArray(root.player.history.timeSkips) ? root.player.history.timeSkips : [];
      root.player.history.timeSkips.push({ years, text: cleanSpaces(raw).slice(0, 160), turn: Number(root.meta && root.meta.currentTurn || 0) });
      markDirty(root, "player", true);
      return 1;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  function addAbilityPriorityContext(root, currentText) {
    const abilities = root && root.abilities;
    if (!abilities || !abilities.byId) return currentText;
    const lines = [];
    const ids = Object.keys(abilities.byId).slice(0, 600);
    const wanted = [];
    ids.forEach(id => {
      const rec = abilities.byId[id];
      if (!rec) return;
      const name = cleanSpaces((rec.identity && (rec.identity.displayName || rec.identity.name)) || rec.displayName || id);
      const blob = toKey(name + " " + JSON.stringify(rec).slice(0, 1000));
      if (blob.indexOf("ember_ward") !== -1 || /(?:Moonlit|Crimson|Hollow|Azure|Thunder|Lotus|Star|Dragon)\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z]+)?/.test(name)) wanted.push({ id, rec, name });
    });
    wanted.slice(0, 5).forEach(row => {
      const rec = row.rec;
      const tags = rec.observation && Array.isArray(rec.observation.semanticTags) ? rec.observation.semanticTags.slice(0, 6).join(", ") : "";
      const apps = rec.meaning && Array.isArray(rec.meaning.emergentApplications) ? rec.meaning.emergentApplications.map(normalizeAbilityEvidenceText).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3).join("; ") : "";
      let line = "AIDRPG PRIORITY ABILITY: " + row.name;
      if (apps) line += " | " + apps;
      if (tags) line += " | tags: " + tags;
      if (lines.indexOf(line) === -1) lines.push(line);
    });
    if (!lines.length) return currentText;
    const packet = lines.join("\n");
    if (currentText.indexOf(lines[0]) !== -1) return currentText;
    const max = (typeof info === "object" && Number(info.maxChars)) ? Math.max(1000, Number(info.maxChars) - 20) : 9000;
    return packet + "\n" + currentText.slice(0, Math.max(120, max - packet.length - 2)).trimEnd();
  }

  function rootPostProcess(raw) {
    const root = ensureRoot();
    const objective = parseQuestAcceptance(raw);
    if (objective) addQuest(root, objective, raw);
    const techs = extractNamedTechniques(raw);
    techs.forEach(name => {
      const app = /afterimage|dash|step/i.test(raw) ? "controlled afterimage dash" : "bounded named technique";
      ensureAbility(root, name, ["named_technique", "bounded"], app, raw);
      mergeOrRemovePartialAbility(root, name);
    });
    sanitizeAbilities(root);
    applyYearAging(root, raw);
    cleanupInventory(root);
    if (root.cache && typeof root.cache === "object") {
      root.cache.contextPacket = "";
      root.cache.playerPacket = "";
      root.cache.scenePacket = "";
    }
  }

  const previousOutput = A.onOutput;
  A.onOutput = function aidrpg130OnOutput(textValue) {
    const raw = textOf(textValue);
    let result;
    try {
      result = previousOutput.call(this, textValue);
    } finally {
      try { rootPostProcess(raw); } catch (error) {
        try { if (A.Utils && A.Utils.logError) A.Utils.logError("v1.3.0 post-process failed: " + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error))); } catch (_error) {}
      }
    }
    return result && typeof result.text === "string" ? result : { text: raw };
  };

  const previousInput = A.onInput;
  A.onInput = function aidrpg130OnInput(textValue) {
    const raw = textOf(textValue);
    const result = previousInput.call(this, textValue);
    try {
      const root = ensureRoot();
      extractNamedTechniques(raw).forEach(name => {
        ensureAbility(root, name, ["named_technique", "input_candidate"], "input-declared named technique", raw);
        mergeOrRemovePartialAbility(root, name);
      });
      sanitizeAbilities(root);
    } catch (_error) {}
    return result && typeof result.text === "string" ? result : { text: raw };
  };

  const previousContext = A.onContext;
  A.onContext = function aidrpg130OnContext(textValue) {
    const root = ensureRoot();
    try { cleanupInventory(root); sanitizeAbilities(root); } catch (_error) {}
    let result = previousContext.call(this, textValue);
    if (!result || typeof result.text !== "string") result = { text: textOf(textValue) };
    result.text = normalizeAbilityEvidenceText(result.text);
    try { result.text = addAbilityPriorityContext(root, result.text); } catch (_error) {}
    return result;
  };

  if (A.InventorySystem && !A.InventorySystem.__aidrpg130InventoryRootFix) {
    const I = A.InventorySystem;
    const oldClean = typeof I.cleanItemPhrase === "function" ? I.cleanItemPhrase : null;
    const oldExtract = typeof I.extractAcquisitionPhrases === "function" ? I.extractAcquisitionPhrases : null;
    I.cleanItemPhrase = function aidrpg130CleanItemPhrase(value) {
      const first = cleanItemPhraseRoot(value);
      if (!first) return "";
      if (oldClean) {
        const second = cleanItemPhraseRoot(oldClean.call(this, first));
        return second || first;
      }
      return first;
    };
    if (oldExtract) {
      I.extractAcquisitionPhrases = function aidrpg130ExtractAcquisitionPhrases(text, root) {
        if (/\b(?:quest|mission|task|request)\s+to\s+(?:recover|retrieve|find|rescue|defeat|clear|deliver|protect)\b/i.test(textOf(text))) {
          const raw = oldExtract.call(this, text, root) || [];
          return raw.map(v => this.cleanItemPhrase(v)).filter(Boolean).filter(v => !isBadInventoryFragment(v)).slice(0, 12);
        }
        const raw = oldExtract.call(this, text, root) || [];
        const out = [];
        const seen = Object.create(null);
        raw.forEach(v => {
          const c = this.cleanItemPhrase(v);
          const k = toKey(c);
          if (c && !seen[k]) { seen[k] = true; out.push(c); }
        });
        return out.slice(0, 12);
      };
    }
    A.InventorySystem.__aidrpg130InventoryRootFix = true;
  }

  A.VERSION = FINAL_VERSION;
  A.BUILD_STAGE = FINAL_STAGE;
  A.__aidrpg130FinalRelease = true;
})();

  function textOf(value) { try { return typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value ?? ""); } catch (_error) { return ""; } }
  function cleanSpaces(value) { return textOf(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); }
  function toKey(value) { return cleanSpaces(value).normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[’'`´”"“]/g, "").replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "").replace(/_+/g, "_"); }
  function titleCase(value) { return cleanSpaces(value).replace(/\b\w/g, ch => ch.toUpperCase()); }
  function ensureRoot() { if (!state.aidrpg || typeof state.aidrpg !== "object" || Array.isArray(state.aidrpg)) { if (A.CoreState && typeof A.CoreState.init === "function") return A.CoreState.init(); state.aidrpg = {}; } return state.aidrpg; }
  function markDirty(root, kind, value) { try { if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.markDirty === "function") A.Utils.markDirty(kind, value == null ? true : value, root); } catch (_error) {} }

  function itemNameOf(rec, id) { if (!rec || typeof rec !== "object") return cleanSpaces(id || ""); return cleanSpaces(rec.displayName || rec.baseType || (rec.identity && (rec.identity.name || rec.identity.displayName)) || id || ""); }
  function removeOwnedItemByKey(root, itemKey, reason) { if (!root || !root.items || !itemKey) return 0; const items = root.items; const byId = items.byId && typeof items.byId === "object" ? items.byId : {}; if (!items.ownership || typeof items.ownership !== "object") items.ownership = {}; const own = Array.isArray(items.ownership.player) ? items.ownership.player : []; let removed = 0; const keep = []; for (let i = 0; i < own.length; i += 1) { const id = own[i]; const rec = byId[id]; const k = toKey(itemNameOf(rec, id)); if (k && k === itemKey) { delete byId[id]; removed += 1; } else keep.push(id); } if (removed) { items.ownership.player = keep; pushParse(root, "v1.3.1 removed non-acquired item " + itemKey + " (" + reason + ")"); markDirty(root, "items", itemKey); } return removed; }

  function key(v) { return clean(v).normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[’'`´\"]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "").replace(/_+/g, "_"); }
  function title(v) { return clean(v).replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase()); }
  function hash(v) { const s = text(v); let h = 5381; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = ((h << 5) + h) ^ s.charCodeAt(i); h >>>= 0; } return String(h); }
  function arr(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : []; }
  function pushUnique(list, value, cap) { if (!Array.isArray(list) || !value) return; if (list.indexOf(value) < 0) list.push(value); if (cap) while (list.length > cap) list.shift(); }
  function root() { return state && state.aidrpg && typeof state.aidrpg === "object" ? state.aidrpg : null; }

  function itemRecordName(rec) { return clean(rec && (rec.displayName || rec.baseType || rec.name || rec.id || "")); }
  function itemIds(r) { return r && r.items && r.items.ownership && Array.isArray(r.items.ownership.player) ? r.items.ownership.player.slice() : []; }
  function itemNames(r) { const out = {}; if (!r || !r.items || !r.items.byId) return out; for (const id of itemIds(r)) { const rec = r.items.byId[id]; const n = itemRecordName(rec); if (n) out[key(n)] = true; } return out; }
  function ensureInventory(r) { if (!r.items || typeof r.items !== "object") r.items = {}; if (!r.items.byId || typeof r.items.byId !== "object") r.items.byId = {}; if (!r.items.ownership || typeof r.items.ownership !== "object") r.items.ownership = {}; if (!Array.isArray(r.items.ownership.player)) r.items.ownership.player = []; if (!r.items.currency || typeof r.items.currency !== "object") r.items.currency = {}; if (!r.items.currency.byType || typeof r.items.currency.byType !== "object") r.items.currency.byType = { copper: 0, silver: 0, gold: 0 }; return r.items; }
  function grantItem(r, raw, source) {
    const name = cleanItem(raw);
    if (!name) return 0;
    const items = ensureInventory(r);
    const nkey = key(name);
    for (const id of items.ownership.player) { const rec = items.byId[id]; if (rec && key(itemRecordName(rec)) === nkey) return 0; }
    const id = "item_" + nkey;
    if (!items.byId[id]) items.byId[id] = { id, displayName: name, baseType: name.split(/\s+/).slice(-1)[0] || name, category: "item", state: "packed", source: source || "v132_confirmed_grant", notes: { sourceContext: source || "v132_confirmed_grant" } };
    pushUnique(items.ownership.player, id, 300);
    try { if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.markDirty === "function") A.Utils.markDirty("items", id, r); if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") A.Utils.invalidatePackets(r); } catch (_) {}
    return 1;
  }
  function removeItemId(r, id) {
    if (!r || !r.items || !r.items.byId) return 0;
    let changed = 0;
    if (r.items.ownership && Array.isArray(r.items.ownership.player)) {
      const before = r.items.ownership.player.length;
      r.items.ownership.player = r.items.ownership.player.filter(x => x !== id);
      if (r.items.ownership.player.length !== before) changed = 1;
    }
    if (r.items.equipment && typeof r.items.equipment === "object") {
      for (const slot of Object.keys(r.items.equipment)) if (r.items.equipment[slot] === id) { r.items.equipment[slot] = null; changed = 1; }
    }
    if (changed && r.items.byId[id]) delete r.items.byId[id];
    return changed;
  }
  function removeNewItems(r, preIds, preNames, names, removeAllNew) {
    if (!r || !r.items || !r.items.byId) return 0;
    const nameSet = {};
    for (const n of arr(names)) { const k = key(n); if (k) nameSet[k] = true; }
    let changed = 0;
    const owned = itemIds(r);
    for (const id of owned) {
      const rec = r.items.byId[id];
      const nm = itemRecordName(rec);
      const nk = key(nm);
      const isNew = preIds.indexOf(id) < 0 && !preNames[nk];
      if (!isNew) continue;
      if (removeAllNew || nameSet[nk] || isBadItemFragment(nm)) changed += removeItemId(r, id);
    }
    return changed;
  }
  function cleanItem(v) {
    let s = clean(v)
      .replace(/^["“”'`]+|["“”'`]+$/g, "")
      .replace(/^(?:a|an|the|some|your|my)\s+/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:from|inside|within|near|beside|by|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:altar|table|floor|ground|shrine|guild chest|ruined chapel|barrow sanctum|corpse|body|guard(?:'s)? pouch|chest)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:and|but)\s+(?:place|put|stash|secure|slip|tuck)\s+(?:it|them)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:and|but)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:before|after|while|when|because|since|until)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+(?:marked|etched|carved)\s+with\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
      .replace(/[.!?;,]+$/g, "")
      .trim();
    if (isBadItemFragment(s)) return "";
    if (/^(?:coins?|gold|silver|copper|money|\d+\s+(?:copper|silver|gold)(?:\s+coins?)?)$/i.test(s)) return "";
    return s;
  }
  function isBadItemFragment(v) {
    const s = low(v);
    if (!s) return true;
    if (/^(?:and|it|them|nothing|no item|no items|only dust|dust|empty air|nothing unusual|nothing useful)$/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/^(?:from|inside|within|near|beside|by|at)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/^(?:place|put|stash|secure|slip|tuck)\s+(?:it|them)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/^(?:recover|repair|escort|deliver|investigate|protect|clear|find|restore|rebuild)\s+.+/.test(s) && /\b(?:relic|wall|bram|letter|tavern|market|gate|quest|sanctum)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/\b(?:snatches?|taken away|empty air|out of reach|illusion|no key here|no item here|before you can|fails? to|cannot|can't|unable)\b/.test(s)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function extractInputItemCandidates(raw) {
    const s = clean(raw); const out = [];
    const pats = [
      /\b(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|loot|snatch|stash|gather|retrieve|recover|scoop\s+up)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|near|beside|inside|after|before|but|and)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig,
      /\breach(?:es)?\s+for\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|near|beside|inside|after|before|but|and)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig
    ];
    for (const re of pats) { let m; while ((m = re.exec(s)) && out.length < 12) { const item = cleanItem(m[1]); if (item) out.push(item); } }
    return out;
  }
  function extractConfirmedItems(raw) {
    const s = clean(raw); const l = low(s); const out = [];
    if (isQuotedInstructionOnly(s)) return out;
    if (hasInventoryDenial(s)) return out;
    const pats = [
      /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:pocket|take|grab|pick\s+up|claim|loot|snatch|stash|gather|retrieve|recover|scoop\s+up)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|near|beside|inside|after|before|and\s+(?:secure|place|put|stash|slip|tuck)|but)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig,
      /\b(?:hands?|gives?|awards?|presents?)\s+you\s+(?:with\s+)?(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|near|beside|inside|after|before|and\s+(?:secure|place|put|stash|slip|tuck)|but)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig,
      /\b(?:presses?|slips?|tucks?)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)\s+into\s+your\s+(?:hand|palm|pack|pouch)\b/ig
    ];
    for (const re of pats) { let m; while ((m = re.exec(s)) && out.length < 12) { const item = cleanItem(m[1]); if (item) out.push(item); } }
    return out;
  }
  function isQuotedInstructionOnly(raw) {
    const s = clean(raw);
    return /["“][^"”]*(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|retrieve|recover)[^"”]*["”]\s*,?\s*(?:\w+\s+)?(?:says?|said|tells?|told|asks?|asked)\b/i.test(s) || /\b(?:says?|said|tells?|told|asks?|asked)\s*:\s*["“]?\s*(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|retrieve|recover)\b/i.test(s);
  }
  function hasInventoryDenial(raw) {
    const s = low(raw);
    return /\bdecid(?:e|es|ed)\s+not\s+to\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|snatch|stash|retrieve|recover)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:do|does|did)\s+not\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|snatch|stash|retrieve|recover)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:fail|fails|failed)\s+to\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|snatch|stash|retrieve|recover)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted)\s+to\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|snatch|stash|retrieve|recover)\b[\s\S]*\bbut\b[\s\S]*\b(?:snatches?|takes?|taken\s+away|locks?|blocked|miss(?:es|ed)?|out\s+of\s+reach|empty\s+air|illusion|nothing|dust|fail|fails|failed|cannot|can't|unable)\b/.test(s)
      || /\breach(?:es|ed)?\s+for\b[\s\S]*\bbut\b[\s\S]*\b(?:miss(?:es|ed)?|stop(?:s|ped)?|empty\s+air|illusion|nothing|dust|snatches?|taken\s+away|out\s+of\s+reach)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:there\s+is|there's|there\s+are)\s+no\s+[^.]{0,40}\b(?:key|item|potion|dagger|sword|shield|crown|coins?)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:you\s+get\s+nothing|hand\s+closes\s+on\s+(?:empty\s+air|dust)|fingers\s+close\s+on\s+dust)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:key|item|potion|dagger|sword|shield|crown)\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:is|was|gets?)\s+taken\s+away\s+before\s+you\s+can\b/.test(s);
  }
  function deniedItemNames(raw, inputNames) {
    const s = clean(raw); const out = arr(inputNames).slice(0, 10);
    const pats = [
      /\bdecid(?:e|es|ed)\s+not\s+to\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|snatch|stash|retrieve|recover)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|before|but|and)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig,
      /\b(?:try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted)\s+to\s+(?:take|grab|pick\s+up|pocket|claim|snatch|stash|retrieve|recover)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|before|but|and)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig,
      /\breach(?:es|ed)?\s+for\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?=\s+(?:from|before|but|and)|[.,;!?]|$)/ig,
      /\b(?:the\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)\s+(?:is|was|gets?)\s+taken\s+away\s+before\s+you\s+can/ig,
      /\bthere\s+(?:is|are)\s+no\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)(?:\s+here|\s+in\s+sight|[.,;!?]|$)/ig
    ];
    for (const re of pats) { let m; while ((m = re.exec(s)) && out.length < 16) { const item = cleanItem(m[1]); if (item) out.push(item); } }
    return out;
  }

  function questDeny(raw) {
    const s = low(raw);
    return /\b(?:decid(?:e|es|ed)\s+not\s+to\s+accept|do(?:es)?\s+not\s+accept|did\s+not\s+accept|declin(?:e|es|ed)|refus(?:e|es|ed)|consider(?:s|ed)?\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:but\s+)?(?:do(?:es)?\s+not|did\s+not)\s+accept)\b[\s\S]{0,100}\bquest\b/.test(s);
  }
  function questObjective(raw) {
    const s = clean(raw);
    const m = s.match(/\b(?:quest|task|mission|job)\s+to\s+(.+?)(?=[.!?;]|$)/i) || s.match(/\b(?:accept|agree\s+to|take|start|commit\s+to)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:to\s+)?((?:recover|find|repair|escort|clear|deliver|investigate|protect|rescue|defeat|restore|rebuild)\b.+?)(?=[.!?;]|$)/i);
    if (!m) return "";
    return clean(m[1]).replace(/\s+from\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:barrow sanctum|altar|guild hall|quest giver)\b[\s\S]*$/i, "").replace(/[.!?;,]+$/g, "").trim();
  }
  function ensureQuest(r, raw) {
    if (questDeny(raw)) return 0;
    const obj = questObjective(raw);
    if (!obj || !/\b(?:recover|find|repair|escort|clear|deliver|investigate|protect|rescue|defeat|restore|rebuild)\b/i.test(obj)) return 0;
    if (!r.quests || typeof r.quests !== "object") r.quests = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(r.quests.active)) r.quests.active = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(r.quests.archived)) r.quests.archived = [];
    if (!r.quests.tracking || typeof r.quests.tracking !== "object") r.quests.tracking = {};
    const id = "quest_" + key(obj);
    for (const q of r.quests.active) if (q && (q.id === id || key(q.objective || q.title || "") === key(obj))) return 0;
    const q = { id, title: title(obj), objective: obj, status: "active", source: "v1.3.2 quest parser", acceptedTurn: r.meta && r.meta.currentTurn || 0, evidence: clean(raw), progressNotes: [] };
    r.quests.active.push(q); r.quests.tracking.primaryQuestId = id; r.quests.tracking.summaryDirty = true;
    try { if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.markDirty === "function") A.Utils.markDirty("quests", true, r); if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidatePackets === "function") A.Utils.invalidatePackets(r); } catch (_) {}
    return 1;
  }
  function removeNewQuestsOnDenial(r, preQuestIds) {
    if (!r || !r.quests || !Array.isArray(r.quests.active)) return 0;
    const before = r.quests.active.length;
    r.quests.active = r.quests.active.filter(q => q && preQuestIds.indexOf(q.id || key(q.title || q.objective || "")) >= 0);
    if (r.quests.tracking && r.quests.tracking.primaryQuestId && !r.quests.active.some(q => q.id === r.quests.tracking.primaryQuestId)) r.quests.tracking.primaryQuestId = r.quests.active[0] ? r.quests.active[0].id : "";
    return before !== r.quests.active.length ? 1 : 0;
  }

  function sceneDenial(raw) {
    const s = clean(raw); const l = low(s);
    if (!/\b(?:try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted|cannot|can't|unable|blocked|stopped|refused)\b/.test(l)) return null;
    if (!/\b(?:enter|go\s+into|reach|access)\b/.test(l) && !/\b(?:blocked|stopped|refused)\s+(?:outside|at)\b/.test(l)) return null;
    if (!/\b(?:but|cannot|can't|unable|blocked|stopped|refused|outside|gate|road)\b/.test(l)) return null;
    const m = s.match(/\b(?:enter|go\s+into|reach|access)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*){0,5})/);
    const place = m ? clean(m[1]) : "";
    if (!place) return null;
    let label = "outside " + place;
    let type = "outside";
    if (/\broad\s+outside\b/i.test(s)) { label = "road outside " + place; type = "road"; }
    else if (/\b(?:gate|gates)\b/i.test(s)) { label = "gate outside " + place; type = "gate"; }
    return { place, label, type };
  }
  function applyDeniedScene(r, info) {
    if (!r || !info) return 0;
    if (!r.world || typeof r.world !== "object") r.world = {};
    const id = "scene_" + key(info.label);
    const cur = r.world.currentScene && typeof r.world.currentScene === "object" ? r.world.currentScene : {};
    r.world.currentScene = Object.assign({}, cur, { sceneRef: id, id, displayName: info.label, name: info.label, sceneType: info.type, entityRef: "", parentLocationRef: "", lastChangedTurn: r.meta && r.meta.currentTurn || 0, sceneConfidence: 3, lastEvidence: "blocked entry: " + info.place });
    if (r.player) { r.player.sceneRef = id; r.player.locationRef = key(info.label); }
    try { if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.invalidateSceneCache === "function") A.Utils.invalidateSceneCache(r); if (A.Utils && typeof A.Utils.markDirty === "function") A.Utils.markDirty("entities", id, r); } catch (_) {}
    return 1;
  }

  function extractAbilityNames(raw) {
    const s = clean(raw); const out = [];
    const pats = [
      /\b(?:channel|use|cast|invoke|practice|attempt\s+to\s+channel|try\s+to\s+channel|try\s+to\s+use)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*){1,5})/g,
      /\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*){1,5})\s+(?:becomes|fails|takes\s+shape|refuses|collapses)\b/g
    ];
    for (const re of pats) { let m; while ((m = re.exec(s)) && out.length < 8) { const n = clean(m[1]).replace(/\s+(?:but|and|from|on)\b[\s\S]*$/i, ""); if (n && !/^(?:You|I|The|A|An|Mira|Elder|After)$/i.test(n)) out.push(n); } }
    return out;
  }
  function abilityDeny(raw) {
    const s = low(raw);
    return /\b(?:try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:channel|use|cast|invoke|form)\b[\s\S]*\b(?:but|however)\b[\s\S]*\b(?:nothing\s+happens|no\s+technique\s+takes\s+shape|fails?|failed|cannot|can't|unable|collapses|refuses)\b/.test(s)
      || /\b(?:nothing\s+happens|no\s+technique\s+takes\s+shape|no\s+spell\s+forms|no\s+ability\s+manifests)\b/.test(s);
  }
  function abilityNorms(r) {
    const out = {}; const ab = r && r.abilities;
    if (!ab || !ab.byId) return out;
    for (const id of Object.keys(ab.byId)) { const rec = ab.byId[id]; const n = rec && rec.identity && (rec.identity.name || rec.identity.displayName) || rec && rec.name || id; out[key(n)] = true; }
    return out;
  }
  function removeDeniedAbilities(r, names, preInputNorms) {
    if (!r || !r.abilities || !r.abilities.byId) return 0;
    const denied = {}; for (const n of names) { const k = key(n); if (k) denied[k] = true; }
    let changed = 0;
    for (const id of Object.keys(r.abilities.byId)) {
      const rec = r.abilities.byId[id]; const n = rec && rec.identity && (rec.identity.name || rec.identity.displayName) || rec && rec.name || id; const nk = key(n);
      if (!denied[nk] || preInputNorms[nk]) continue;
      delete r.abilities.byId[id]; changed = 1;
      for (const listName of ["allIds", "skillIds", "talentIds", "passiveIds"]) if (Array.isArray(r.abilities[listName])) r.abilities[listName] = r.abilities[listName].filter(x => x !== id);
      if (r.abilities.byKey && typeof r.abilities.byKey === "object") for (const k of Object.keys(r.abilities.byKey)) if (r.abilities.byKey[k] === id || k === nk) delete r.abilities.byKey[k];
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function deniedYearSkip(raw) {
    const s = low(raw); if (!/\b(?:try|tries|tried|attempt|attempts|attempted)\b/.test(s) || !/\bbut\b/.test(s)) return 0;
    if (!/\b(?:sleep|wait|rest|meditate|hibernate)\b/.test(s)) return 0;
    const n = { a:1, an:1, one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10, eleven:11, twelve:12, thirteen:13, fourteen:14, fifteen:15, sixteen:16, seventeen:17, eighteen:18, nineteen:19, twenty:20, thirty:30, forty:40, fifty:50, sixty:60, seventy:70, eighty:80, ninety:90 };
    const m = s.match(/\b(\d+|a|an|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety)\s+years?\b/);
    if (!m) return 0;
    return /^\d+$/.test(m[1]) ? Math.floor(+m[1]) : (n[m[1]] || 0);
  }
  function actualShortHours(raw) {
    const s = low(raw); const n = { one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10, a:1, an:1 };
    const m = s.match(/\bafter\s+(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|a|an)\s+hours?\b/);
    if (!m) return 0;
    return /^\d+$/.test(m[1]) ? +m[1] : (n[m[1]] || 0);
  }

  function ensureNegativeRumor(r, raw) {
    const s = clean(raw); const l = low(s);
    if (!/\bword\s+spreads|rumors?\s+spread|people\s+say|known\s+as\b/.test(l)) return 0;
    if (!/\b(?:betray|betrayed|caused|burned|poisoned|murdered|stole|traitor|criminal|blame|guilty|fire)\b/.test(l)) return 0;
    const place = (s.match(/\b(?:in|through|around)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’]*){0,3})\b/) || [])[1] || "local rumor";
    if (!r.reputation || typeof r.reputation !== "object") r.reputation = {};
    if (!r.reputation.bySubject || typeof r.reputation.bySubject !== "object") r.reputation.bySubject = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(r.reputation.rumors)) r.reputation.rumors = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(r.reputation.recentChanges)) r.reputation.recentChanges = [];
    const id = "reputation_" + key(place);
    const rec = r.reputation.bySubject[id] || { identity: { id, displayName: place, scope: "local" }, mutable: { score: 0, standing: "neutral", tags: [], notes: [], lastChangedTurn: 0 } };
    rec.mutable.score = Math.min(Number(rec.mutable.score || 0) - 12, -12);
    rec.mutable.standing = "negative rumor";
    pushUnique(rec.mutable.tags, "negative_rumor", 12); pushUnique(rec.mutable.notes, s, 10); rec.mutable.lastChangedTurn = r.meta && r.meta.currentTurn || 0;
    r.reputation.bySubject[id] = rec;
    r.reputation.rumors.push({ turn: r.meta && r.meta.currentTurn || 0, subject: place, direction: "negative", label: "negative rumor", text: s }); while (r.reputation.rumors.length > 20) r.reputation.rumors.shift();
    r.reputation.recentChanges.push({ turn: r.meta && r.meta.currentTurn || 0, subject: place, subjectId: id, direction: "negative", delta: -12, evidence: s }); while (r.reputation.recentChanges.length > 20) r.reputation.recentChanges.shift();
    return 1;
  }
  function suppressHiddenPositiveRep(r, raw, preRepJson) {
    const l = low(raw);

# AIDRPG Whole-System Tester Starter

This is the first usable build of your local AIDRPG tester.

It does **not** automate the live AI Dungeon website. It runs your AI Dungeon-style script locally, sends it fake player inputs and fake AI outputs, checks state/debug/context behavior, and writes a repair report.

## What this starter can do now

- Load `aidrpg-script.js`
- Create fake AI Dungeon globals: `state`, `info`, `history`, `storyCards`, `memory`, `text`, `stop`
- Mock Story Card functions: `addStoryCard`, `updateStoryCard`, `removeStoryCard`
- Run `AIDRPG.onInput(text)`
- Run `AIDRPG.onContext(text)`
- Run `AIDRPG.onOutput(text)`
- Run smoke/core/intent/basic integration tests
- Generate starter inventory stress variations
- Write Markdown and JSON reports
- Group failures and show state diffs

## Chromebook setup

1. Turn on Linux on your Chromebook:

   Settings → About ChromeOS → Developers → Linux development environment → Set up

2. Open the Linux Terminal.

3. Install Node.js:

```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y nodejs npm
node -v
npm -v
```

4. Unzip this folder and open it:

```bash
cd aidrpg-tester-starter
```

5. Put your latest full AIDRPG script into:

```text
aidrpg-script.js
```

This starter already includes the uploaded `Chunk1-22(3).txt` as `aidrpg-script.js`, but replace it whenever you have a newer chunk.

6. Run the smoke test:

```bash
node runner.js --suite smoke
```

7. Open the report:

```bash
cat reports/latest-report.md
```

## Useful commands

```bash
node runner.js --suite smoke
node runner.js --suite core
node runner.js --suite intent
node runner.js --suite inventory --limit 50
node runner.js --suite integration
node runner.js --suite all --limit 200
node runner.js --rerun-failures
```

## What to paste back into ChatGPT

After a run, paste:

```text
reports/latest-report.md
```

or, for a shorter patch request:

```text
reports/ai-review-package.md
```

Then ask:

> Patch the AIDRPG script based on this tester report. Focus only on the highest severity failures and avoid whole-library rewrites.

## Important expectation

This starter is Phase 1. It proves the local test loop works. The later phases add deeper inventory verification, exact resolver tracing, full state path assertions, and more system-specific tests.

#!/usr/bin/env node
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { createRuntime } = require('./runtime/fake-aid-runtime');
const { diffValues } = require('./runtime/state-snapshot');
const { evaluateAssertion } = require('./runtime/assertions');
const { writeReports } = require('./runtime/report-writer');
const { getGeneratedTests } = require('./generators/whole-system-generator');

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const args = { suite: 'smoke', limit: null, includePassed: false, rerunFailures: false, generatedOnly: false, staticOnly: false };
  for (let i = 2; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
    const arg = argv[i];
    if (arg === '--suite') args.suite = argv[++i] || 'smoke';
    else if (arg === '--limit') args.limit = Number(argv[++i] || 0) || null;
    else if (arg === '--include-passed') args.includePassed = true;
    else if (arg === '--rerun-failures') args.rerunFailures = true;
    else if (arg === '--generated-only') args.generatedOnly = true;
    else if (arg === '--static-only') args.staticOnly = true;
    else if (arg === '--help' || arg === '-h') args.help = true;
  }
  return args;
}

function showHelp() {
  console.log(`AIDRPG Whole-System Tester v0.3

Usage:
  node runner.js --suite smoke
  node runner.js --suite core
  node runner.js --suite intent
  node runner.js --suite inventory --limit 100
  node runner.js --suite context
  node runner.js --suite integration
  node runner.js --suite full --limit 300
  node runner.js --suite all --limit 300
  node runner.js --rerun-failures

Suites:
  smoke, core, intent, player, inventory, time, scene, world, abilities, traits,
  context, actors, validation, integration, regressions, full/all
`);
}

function loadJsonTestsFromDir(dir) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json')).sort();
  const out = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    const full = path.join(dir, file);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8'));
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) out.push(...parsed);
    else if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.tests)) out.push(...parsed.tests);
  }
  return out;
}

function getStaticTestsForSuite(suite) {
  const root = process.cwd();
  const suitesDir = path.join(root, 'suites');
  let tests = [];
  if (!fs.existsSync(suitesDir)) return tests;
  const normalized = suite === 'full' ? 'all' : suite;
  if (normalized === 'all') {
    const names = fs.readdirSync(suitesDir).filter(f => fs.statSync(path.join(suitesDir, f)).isDirectory());
    for (const name of names) tests.push(...loadJsonTestsFromDir(path.join(suitesDir, name)));
  } else if (normalized === 'core') {
    tests.push(...loadJsonTestsFromDir(path.join(suitesDir, 'core-state')));
    tests.push(...loadJsonTestsFromDir(path.join(suitesDir, 'turn-engine')));
  } else {
    tests.push(...loadJsonTestsFromDir(path.join(suitesDir, normalized)));
  }
  return tests;
}

function getTestsForSuite(args) {
  const suite = args.suite === 'all' ? 'full' : args.suite;
  let tests = [];
  if (!args.generatedOnly) tests.push(...getStaticTestsForSuite(suite));
  if (!args.staticOnly) tests.push(...getGeneratedTests(suite, { limit: args.limit }));

  const seen = new Set();
  tests = tests.filter(t => {
    const key = `${t.suite || ''}:${t.name || ''}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  if (args.limit && tests.length > args.limit && suite !== 'inventory') tests = tests.slice(0, args.limit);
  return tests;
}

function normalizeTest(test) {
  return Object.assign({
    name: '(unnamed test)', suite: 'unknown', initialState: {}, initialInfo: {}, initialHistory: [], initialStoryCards: [], initialMemory: {}, steps: [], assertions: []
  }, test);
}

function runTest(rawTest, scriptPath) {
  const test = normalizeTest(rawTest);
  const runtime = createRuntime({
    state: test.initialState || {},
    info: test.initialInfo || {},
    history: test.initialHistory || [],
    storyCards: test.initialStoryCards || [],
    memory: test.initialMemory || {}
  });

  const result = {
    name: test.name,
    suite: test.suite,
    expectedSystem: test.expectedSystem || '',
    description: test.description || '',
    whyItMatters: test.whyItMatters || '',
    patchHint: test.patchHint || '',
    severity: test.severity || '',
    passed: true,
    steps: [],
    assertions: [],
    errors: [],
    stateDiffs: [],
    debugOutputs: [],
    logs: [],
    storyCardOps: []
  };

  try {
    runtime.loadScript(scriptPath);
  } catch (err) {
    result.passed = false;
    result.errors.push(String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err));
    return result;
  }

  for (const step of test.steps || []) {
    const before = runtime.snapshot();
    let hookReturn = null;
    try {
      hookReturn = runtime.runHook(step.hook, step.text || '');
      result.lastReturn = hookReturn;
      runtime.context.lastReturn = hookReturn;
      if (step.addHistory !== false && (step.hook === 'input' || step.hook === 'output')) {
        runtime.addHistory(step.hook === 'input' ? 'do' : 'story', step.text || '');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.errors.push(String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err));
    }
    const after = runtime.snapshot();
    const diffs = diffValues(before.state, after.state, 'state', [], 120);
    result.stateDiffs.push(...diffs);
    result.steps.push({ hook: step.hook, text: step.text || '', returnValue: hookReturn });
    if (step.captureDebug) {
      result.debugOutputs.push({ command: step.text || '', text: hookReturn && hookReturn.text ? hookReturn.text : '' });
    }
  }

  for (const assertion of test.assertions || []) {
    const checked = evaluateAssertion(assertion, runtime, result);
    const entry = Object.assign({}, assertion, checked);
    if (!entry.passed) result.passed = false;
    result.assertions.push(entry);
  }

  result.logs = runtime.getLogs();
  result.storyCardOps = runtime.getStoryCardOps();
  return result;
}

function loadFailuresAsTests() {
  const failuresPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'reports', 'failures-only.json');
  if (!fs.existsSync(failuresPath)) throw new Error('No reports/failures-only.json found. Run a suite first.');
  const previous = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(failuresPath, 'utf8'));
  return previous.map(f => ({
    name: f.name, suite: f.suite, expectedSystem: f.expectedSystem, description: f.description, whyItMatters: f.whyItMatters, patchHint: f.patchHint,
    steps: f.steps || [],
    assertions: (f.assertions || []).map(a => {
      const keep = { type: a.type };
      for (const key of ['path','expected','limit','min','max']) if (key in a) keep[key] = a[key];
      return keep;
    })
  }));
}

function main() {
  const args = parseArgs(process.argv);
  if (args.help) return showHelp();

  const scriptPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'aidrpg-script.js');
  if (!fs.existsSync(scriptPath)) {
    console.error('Missing aidrpg-script.js. Put your latest AIDRPG script in this folder.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  let tests = [];
  try {
    tests = args.rerunFailures ? loadFailuresAsTests() : getTestsForSuite(args);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err));
    process.exit(1);
  }

  if (!tests.length) {
    console.error(`No tests found for suite: ${args.suite}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const results = tests.map(t => runTest(t, scriptPath));
  const paths = writeReports(results, {
    suite: args.rerunFailures ? 'rerun-failures' : args.suite,
    includePassed: args.includePassed,
    reportDir: path.join(process.cwd(), 'reports'),
    scriptPath
  });

  const passed = results.filter(r => r.passed).length;
  const failed = results.length - passed;
  console.log(`Done. Cases tested: ${results.length}. Passed: ${passed}. Failed: ${failed}.`);
  console.log(`Report: ${paths.latestMd}`);
  console.log(`Patch targets: ${paths.patchTargets}`);
  if (failed) console.log('Paste reports/ai-review-package.md back into ChatGPT for patch guidance.');
}

main();

# AIDRPG Tester v0.5 Notes

This update tightens the tester around AI Dungeon-specific scripting behavior rather than generic JavaScript behavior.

## New AI Dungeon-specific suites

- `aid-runtime`: checks hook return shape, stop misuse, state size, storyCard count, and approximate 2-second hook timing.
- `context-pressure`: seeds crowded history and Story Cards, then checks whether immediate current truth still appears in script-generated context.
- `story-cards`: stresses duplicate/near-duplicate Story Card pressure and verifies current scene truth is not dependent only on Story Card matching.
- `npc-deep`: runs varied NPC phrasing/output tests for trust, hostility, injury, following, betrayal, fear, and merchant relationships.
- `model-style`: tests prose patterns that AI Dungeon often produces: implied item grants, dialogue/body-language relationship changes, failed attempts, and hedged/uncertain rumors.

## New assertion support

- `noStopTrue`
- `stateSizeUnderBytes`
- `storyCardCountAtMost`
- `maxHookRuntimeMs`

## Why this update matters

AI Dungeon scripts run in Input, Context, and Output hooks; output memory changes only matter on later actions; Context has limited space; Story Cards are dynamic and can be omitted; and each hook is sandboxed with memory/time limits. This tester version starts checking those actual failure modes.

# AIDRPG Whole-System Tester v0.6 Coverage Audit

This version tightens the tester against the planned AIDRPG system and adds the missing time-focused suite.

## AI Dungeon-specific coverage

- Hook return shape and stop behavior checks
- Hook timeout checks against AI Dungeon's 2-second script timeout expectation
- State size checks against sandbox pressure
- Context pressure tests with crowded history and story cards
- Story Card duplicate/bloat tests
- Output-memory-next-turn risk modeled through context follow-up tests
- Immediate truth checks: state -> Context, not Story Cards alone

## Current-stage Chunk 22 coverage

The following suites are considered current-stage blockers or warnings by Chunk 22:

- smoke
- core-state
- turn-engine
- intent
- player
- progression
- inventory
- story-items
- scene
- world
- time
- abilities
- traits
- validation
- context
- context-pressure
- actors / npc / npc-deep
- integration
- simulation
- aid-runtime

Future-stage systems are still present as warning/final-version coverage when relevant:

- reputation
- quests
- card-sync
- selective long-term major actor memory

## Added in v0.6

### Deep TimeTravelSystem suite

Added tests for:

- /time debug visibility
- thirty-minute travel advancement
- duplicate-output idempotency for time advancement
- three-hour wait phrase parsing
- overnight rest/day rollover expectations
- vague “moments later” soft handling
- “earlier today” relative reference safety
- impossible time contradiction flagging
- route duration memory
- time context exposure after travel
- Input rest intent vs Output-confirmed actual advancement

### Scene/World expansion

Added tests for:

- pending travel vs confirmed arrival
- confirmed chapel arrival scene truth
- burned/barricaded tavern mutable state
- building ownership/layout/material/district preservation

### Report maturity labels

Reports now include a `Roadmap maturity` field when a test marks itself as:

- CURRENT_BLOCKER
- CURRENT_WARNING
- FUTURE_EXPECTATION
- FINAL_VERSION_EXPECTATION

This helps avoid treating not-yet-built future systems as current failures.

## Suggested commands

```bash
node runner.js --suite smoke
node runner.js --suite aid-runtime
node runner.js --suite time --generated-only
node runner.js --suite scene --generated-only
node runner.js --suite world --generated-only
node runner.js --suite context-pressure --generated-only
node runner.js --suite npc-deep --generated-only --limit 50
node runner.js --suite deep --generated-only --limit 150
```

## Still expandable later

The next useful improvements would be deeper coverage for:

- reputation/quest once Chunk 23 is installed
- CardSync once Chunk 24 is installed
- selective long-term major actor memory once Chunk 25 is installed
- combat/matchup stress testing if the combat resolution layer grows more complex

# AIDRPG Tester v0.7 — AI Dungeon Action Mode Semantics

Adds validation tests for Do/Say/Story/action-mode semantics and parser discipline.

Run:

```bash
node runner.js --suite action-modes
node runner.js --suite mode-semantics
```

Checks added:
- speaking an item name does not grant it
- saying “I take X” does not take X
- spoken /sheet does not execute
- exact /sheet still executes
- Do input does not mutate inventory before output
- confirmed output grants once
- retried output does not duplicate commit
- NPC dialogue telling the player to take something does not grant it
- negative/hypothetical output does not commit success
- spoken time phrases do not advance time
- output-confirmed time passage advances time

# AIDRPG Dungeon Simulation Tester Reference

## Purpose

This tester upgrade adds a fixed three-chamber dungeon simulation to the AIDRPG tester. It is designed to complement isolated stress tests by running short AI Dungeon-style adventure flows with player input, team dialogue, combat, healing, injuries, known ability use, new technique attempts, loot, XP/progression, context pressure, negative controls, and duplicate/retry checks.

The goal is not to randomize a dungeon. The goal is to use a stable, repeatable dungeon so each script version can be compared against the same expected gameplay paths.

## Standard dungeon

The dungeon is the Old Barrow:

1. Barrow Entry Hall
   - party setup with Mira and Bram
   - scene confirmation
   - trap/pressure plate branch
   - team dialogue and safety checks

2. Ruined Armory
   - skeletal guard combat
   - known ability use
   - loot and currency
   - XP/progression checks
   - victory/failure split

3. Sealed Sanctum
   - key gate
   - boss/warden-style encounter
   - known ability adaptation
   - injury/healing branches
   - context pressure checks

## Suites added

Run all dungeon tests:

```bash
node runner.js --suite dungeon-full --generated-only --include-passed
```

Run specific sections:

```bash
node runner.js --suite dungeon-run --generated-only --include-passed
node runner.js --suite dungeon-branches --generated-only --include-passed
node runner.js --suite dungeon-ability --generated-only --include-passed
node runner.js --suite dungeon-combat --generated-only --include-passed
node runner.js --suite dungeon-context-pressure --generated-only --include-passed
node runner.js --suite dungeon-negative-controls --generated-only --include-passed
```

## What this tests

- fixed multi-turn dungeon flow
- scene transitions across rooms/chambers
- party/NPC relevance with Mira and Bram
- trap avoided / minor injury / major injury / poison branches
- healing by item and companion
- known ability use and revision
- explicit new technique training
- output-only skill hallucination rejection
- similar ability-name confusion
- combat victory, failure, proportional XP, loot, and currency
- duplicate/retry protection for reward outputs
- context pressure with cluttered history/story cards
- negative controls where dialogue/speculation/memory should not hard-save state

## Why this helps

Isolated tests tell you whether one system works in one phrase. The dungeon simulation checks whether major planned systems survive a short realistic play sequence together. This catches integration failures such as:

- inventory works but context omits the key
- abilities update in isolation but not in combat flow
- injury saves but healing does not revise it
- NPCs exist but do not remain relevant in context
- victory output grants loot but failed attack output also grants loot
- output-only skill hallucinations become permanent abilities
- duplicate model output doubles XP, currency, or effects

## How to read the results

Failures are grouped by likely system. The most useful files are:

- `reports/latest-report.md`
- `reports/patch-targets.md`
- `reports/ai-review-package.md`

Use the dungeon suite as a final-product integration test. Some failures may be future expectations depending on current roadmap stage, but they are intentionally included because the dungeon runner is meant to validate the final whole RPG framework.
